elikōptar (Helicopter) kāṟṟilum pārkkap pāraṅkūṭiya paṟakkum entiram. itaṟku iṟakkikaḷ illi; mūṉṟu alakukaḷālāṉa cuḻaluṅkāṟṟāṭi mēlē uṇṭu. mutaṉ mutal (1923il) ivvaki vimāṉattil paṟantavar pireñcup poṟivallārākiya urōlṭi pā°karā (Raoul de Pascara) itaṉāl nērkuttāka iṟaṅkavum eḻumpavum muṭiyum. itaṉ vāṟpuṟat tilum mūṉṟu alakukaḷālāṉa ciṟiya cuḻalum kāṟṟāṭiyuṇṭu. vimāṉa niliyaṅkaḷillāta iṭaṅkaḷilum itaṉāl iṟaṅkavum eḻumpavum muṭiyum.
eṟikuṇṭu (Grenade): 25 yār tūram variyil eṟiyappaṭum eṟikuṇṭu. kuṇṭu veṭikkumiṭattiliruntu 30 aṭi tūrattiluḷḷa poruḷkaḷel lām apāyattukkuḷḷākum. itu kikalappup pōril etirikaḷ mītu eṟiyappaṭuvatu.
ēriyal: (Aerial) vāṉolikkaruviyiṉ pakuti; cūḻntuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷukku miṉ caktiyip parappuvatu. itu kāppu iṭappaṭṭa (Insutaled)kampi allatu kampiccuruḷākavirukkum.
oṭṭō kirō (Autogyro) kāṟṟilum pāramāṉa paṟakkum entiram. itu elikkōptar (Helicopter) vimāṉattippōla nērkuttāka eḻumpa vum iṟaṅkavum kūṭiyatu. itaṉ iṟakkikaḷ uṟutiyāka iruppataṟkup patil cuḻalukkūṭiyavi. itu iṟaṅkuvataṟku atika iṭam vēṇṭiya tilli. itu vīṭṭuk kūrikaḷilum iṟaṅkakkūṭum. itaṉi mutaliṟ ceytavar Jaun de la cierva eṉṉum i°pāṉiyar (1924)
oliparapputal: (Broadcasting) vāṉoli niliyattiluḷḷa karuvi mūlam ceytikaḷiyum icikaḷiyum parapputal. ivvāṟu oli perukkak kūṭum ceytikaḷi vāṅki veḷiviṭakkūṭiya karuvi irēṭiyōp peṭṭi (Receiving set) eṉappaṭukiṟatu.
oliperukki: (Loud Speaker) itu oliyi miṉcāra caktiyāka māṟṟi atit tirumpa atē oliyāka urakkakkēṭkumpaṭi māṟṟakkūṭiya karuvi.
olippativuḷḷa ciṉimāppaṭam: (Sound film): ciṉimāppaṭak kāṭci toṭaṅkiya kālam mutal paṭaṅkaḷukku oliyi iṇippataṟku vēṇṭiya muyaṟ cikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭu vantaṉa. toṭakkattil oliyillāta pilmkaḷukku kirāmapōṉ taṭṭukaḷ mūlam oli utavappaṭṭatu. pilmiṉ oru orattil oli patiyappaṭukiṟatu. paṭam tiriyil kāṭṭappaṭum pōtu oli mīṭpu oliyāka veḷippaṭukiṟatu. itu tirikkup piṉpuṟattiliruntu varumāṟu oliperukki mūlam veḷiyiṭappaṭukiṟatu.
urupperukkum āṭi (Magnifying glass): itu oru kuvileṉ°. itaṉūṭāka oru poruḷip pārttāl apporuḷ peritākat terikiṟatu. itaṉic cīṉarum piṟarum muṟkālattil aṟintiruntaṉar.
kaṭal tantikkampi iṇippu: (Cable-laying) mutal tanti kalē° (Calis) uṭōvar (Dover) eṉṉum iru iṭaṅkaḷukkumiṭiyil 1850il pōṭappaṭṭatu. iṉṟu ēṟakkuṟiya 4,50,000 kaṭalmil tūrattukkuk kaṇṭaṅkaḷi iṇittukoṇṭirukkum kaṭal tantikkampikaḷ pōṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
kaṭalvimāṉam: (Sea Plane) tari vimāṉaṅkaḷukkuk kīḻē cakkaraṅkaḷ poruttappaṭṭirukkum. kaṭal vimāṉaṅkaḷukkuc cakkaraṅkaḷukkup patil mitavikaḷ irukkum. ivaṟṟukkuk kaṭaliliṟaṅkavum kaṭali liruntu mēlē paṟakkavum muṭiyum.
kaṭikāram: kālamaḷakkuṅ karuvi. itaṉ iyaṅku cakti paḷu, vil (Spring) allatu miṉcārattiṉāl utavappaṭalām. muṟkālattil vaḻaṅkiya maṇaṟ kaṭikārattil maṇaliṉ paḷuvē iyaṅku caktiyāka viruntatu. paḷuvik koṇṭu iyaṅkum kaṭikāram 2ām cilve°tarāl (Pope Silverster II) ceyyappaṭṭateṉa (ki.pi. 1,000) nampappaṭukiṟatu. ik kāla vakiyāṉa ciṟukaṭikāram cermaṉiyil nūrempek eṉṉum iṭattil vāḻnta oruvarāl 15ām nūṟṟāṇṭil ceyyappaṭṭatu.
kēmirā: (Camera) oru pakkattil ciṟu tuvāramuḷḷa peṭṭi. tuvārattiṉ vaḻiyē veḷiccam ceṉṟu kāṭciyiṉ niḻalip peṭṭiyiṉ aṭutta cuvaril talikīḻāka viḻacceyyum. iv vakik kamirāvi ili ṉārṭō ṭāviṉci (Leonardo da vinci) eṉṉum ittāliyar 1,500-l kaṇṭupiṭittār. itiliruntu iṉṟu paṭampiṭikkum vakiyāṉa kamirā vaḷarcciyaṭintatu.
kalvaṉik miṉkala aṭukku: (Galvanic Battery) itu vōlṭā (Volta) eṉṉum ittāliyarāl 1800il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. iraṇṭu vaki ulō kaṅkaḷ amilattōṭu campantappaṭumpōtu miṉṉēṟṟa muṇṭākiṟa teṉṉum aṭippaṭiyik koṇṭu itu tayārikkappaṭukiṟatu. ovvoru miṉkalattilum kantaka amilattil naṉinta tuṇiyiṉāl maṟikkappaṭṭa nāka, cemput takaṭukaḷ vikkappaṭum, ivvaki miṉkala aṭukkukaḷ pala oṉṟāka iṇikkappaṭum. ikkāla akkumi lēṭṭarkaḷukku muṉ vaḻaṅkiyavi ivvaki miṉkala aṭukkukaḷē.
kaṟparappiya vīti: pāpilōṉiyarum intiyarum ki.mu. 2,000 variyil kaṟparappiya vītikaḷi amittaṉar. kirēkkarum avvaki vītikaḷi amittaṉar. urōmar irāṇuvat tēvikaḷukkāka vītikaḷamikkum muṟiyit tiṭṭappaṭuttiṉar. piriṭṭaṉil urōmar amitta vītikaḷ 16aṭi akalamuḷḷaṉa. ikkāla muṟiyāṉa vītiyamippu 1,800-l toṭaṅkiyatu.
kāṟṟukkoḷḷum cakkara vaḷiyaṅkaḷ: īruruḷi (picikkiḷ) mōṭṭār vaṇṭi vimāṉaṅkaḷukkup payaṉpaṭuttum kāṟṟukkoḷḷum vaḷi yaṅkaḷ iṭaṉlop (Boyd Dunlop) eṉṉum i°kottiyarāl 1888il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
kuḷir kāppuppeṭṭi: (Refrigerator) taṉatu uḷveḷiyiluḷḷa vāyuvik kuḷiracceytu veppatti akaṟṟakkūṭiya entiram. itu uṇavup poruḷkaḷik keṭāmalum kuḷirākavum vittiruppataṟkup peritum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
caṟukku vimāṉam: (Glider) itu entiramillāta vimāṉam. kāṟṟāṭip paṭṭattip pōla mēlē paṟakkumpaṭi itaṉi iḻuttuppiṭikkum kayiṟṟi veṭṭi viṭṭāl itu kāṟṟiṟ paṟantu cellum.ivvakic caṟukki vimāṉatti mutaṉ mutal celuttiyavar oṭṭō lilintal (Otto Lilienthal). ivar 1896il caṟukku vimāṉattōṭu viḻuntu maraṇa māṉār. caṟukku vimāṉam 6 maṇi nērattil 195 mil paṟantirukkiṟatu.
ciṉimāppaṭakkāṭci: (Cinematograph) oru toṭarpāṉa paṭaṅkaḷi cellu lōyiṭ pilmil virivākap piṭittu avaṟṟit tiriyil viḻumpaṭi yākak kāṭṭuvatu. taṉittaṉippaṭaṅkaḷ virivāka oṭik koṇṭiruppa tāl paṭaṅkaḷ uṇmiyil naṭamāṭuvatupōlat tōṉ ṟum. oru tōṟṟam kaṇṇil paṭṭu maṟinta piṉpum viṉāṭiyil oru pakuti nēram kaṇṇukkup pulaṉākik koṇṭirukkumātaliṉ vēkamāka ōṭum paṭaṅkaḷ oṉṟōṭoṉṟu cērntiruppatākat tōṉṟum. 1926il ippaṭaṅkaḷukku oliyiyum cērttup payaṉpaṭuttum muṟi aṟiyap paṭṭatu. 1890il cellulōyiṭ pilm kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. ciṉimā paṭam piṭikkum kamirāvi ulūmayari (Lumiere) eṉṉum pirāṉciyarum avar cakōtararum 1895il ceytārkaḷ.
cēvṭi lāmp: (Safety Lamp) iṭēvi (Humphry Davy) eṉpavarāl 1815l kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. itu curaṅkaṅkaḷil vēṟu vaki viḷakkukakaḷip payaṉpaṭuttuvatāl tīppiṭittu apāya muṇṭāvatit taṭuppataṟkākac ceyyappaṭṭatu. itu iṉṟum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.
taṭṭaccu: (Typewriter) ilitām cōl° (Lithamsholes) eṉpavar mutal taṭṭacci 1868-l ceytār. itu iremiṅṭaṉ kampaṉiyārāl viyāpāramuṟiyil ceyyappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.
tanti: puḷḷi, kīṟu eṉṉum aṭiyāḷaṅkaḷikkoṇṭu miṉcārak karuvimūlam koṭukkappaṭum ceyti muṟi. itaṉ “kōṭṭu” mōr° eṉṉum amerikkarāl oḻuṅkupaṭuttappaṭṭatu. iṉṟu tanti perum pālum teli piriṇṭēr° (Teleprinters) mūlam naṭipeṟukiṟatu.
tāṅkikaḷ: (Tanks) muṟkāla niṭṭukaḷ (Knights) tamatu uṭalip palavaki ulōkak kavacaṅkaḷāl maṟintārkaḷ. tāṅkikaḷ eṉpaṉa kavacantāṅkiya mōṭṭahr vaṇṭikaḷ. tāṅkikaḷukkuc cakkaraṅkaḷukkup patil kampaḷip puḻuviṉ kālpōṉṟa caṅkili amippu uṇṭu. avi paḷḷam mēṭu uḷḷa vaḻikaḷāl cellakkūṭiyavi. niṭṭukaḷiṉ kavacaṅkaḷiṉ vaḷarcciyē tāṅkiyākum.
ticikāṭṭi: (Compass) tici kāṭṭuṅkaruvi. kāntamēṟṟappaṭṭa ūciyit taṭiyiṉṟic cuḻalumpaṭi naṭuvil camaṉceytu vittāl atiṉ oru muṉi kānta turuvatti (vaṭakki) nōkkum. mārk kōppōlō cīṉāviliruntu tirumpiyapiṉ ticiyaṟi karuviyippaṟṟi airōp piyarukkut terivittāṉ. ūci nēr vaṭakkik kāṭṭātu.kānta turuvattik kāṭṭukiṉṟateṉpatu kolampacāl aṟiyappaṭṭiruntatu.
tirāmvē: (Tramway) pukivaṇṭit toṭarip pōlat taṇṭapāḷattil cellum pōkkuvarattuc cātaṉam. itu virivil maṟintu varukiṉ ṟatu. kutirikaḷāl iḻukkappaṭum tirām vaṇṭic cēvi niyūyōkkil toṭaṅkiṟṟu. 1881il miṉcārattiṉāl celuttappaṭum tirām cēvi cērmaṉiyil toṭaṅkiyatu. kutirikaḷāliḻukkappaṭum tirāmvē ilaṇṭaṉil 1905vari iruntatu. tirāmvēyiṉ iṭatti ippoḻutu turolli pa°kaḷ (Trolley Bus) eṭuttu varukiṉṟaṉa.
telipōṉ: miṉcārak kampimūlam olikaḷic celuttuvataṟkuḷḷa karuvi. itu oliyi miṉcāra aliyāka māṟṟi maṟṟap pakkattil maṟupaṭiyum oli alikaḷāka veḷiyiṭukiṟatu. alakcāntar kirakāmpel eṉpavar itaṉi 1876il kaṇṭupiṭittār.
tiyal entiram: itu eliya° hō (Elias Howe) eṉṉum amerikkarāl 1845-l kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. ataṉip piṉpaṟṟic ciṅkar (I.M.Singer) tiyal entiraṅkaḷic ceytār. ippoḻutu vaḻaṅkum tiyal entiraṅkaḷ ivventira amippip piṉpaṟṟic ceyyappaṭuvaṉa.
tolikkāṭci: (Television) niḻal vaṭivatti irēṭiyō alikaḷ mūlam celuttutal. tolikkāṭci mutaṉmutal yōṉpayāṭ eṉpavarāl 1926il kāṭṭappaṭṭatu. mutal tolikāṭci niliyam ilaṇṭaṉi luḷḷa alekcāṇṭar palē° eṉṉumiṭattil 1936il ārampikkap paṭṭatu. vāṉolip peṭṭiyil nām oliyi māttiram kēṭkiṟōm. tolik kāṭcip peṭṭiyil oliyik kēṭpatōṭu uruvaṅkaḷi yum kāṇkiṉṟōm.
tolinōkki: (Telescope) toliviluḷḷa poruḷkaḷik kiṭṭa iruppatākak kāṭṭum āṭi. itu mutaṉ mutal urocar pēkaṉ (Roger Bacon) eṉpavarāl 13ām nūṟṟāṇṭil ceyyappaṭṭatu. kaliliyō 1609il ceyta tolinōkkiyiṉ amippip piṉpaṟṟi ikkālat toli nōkkikaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
nili miṉkāṭṭi: (Electroscope) miṉṉēṟṟam iruppati aṟivikkum karuvi. itu kāveṇṭiṣ (Hentry Carvendish) eṉṉum āṅkila viññāṉiyāl 1790-l kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
nīrmūḻki: nīrukkuk kīḻāl cellakkūṭiya amippil ceyyappaṭṭa kappal. ik kāla muṟiyāṉa nīr mūḻki holaṇṭ eṉṉum ayarlāntu vāciyāl amerikkāvil 1875-l kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. nīrmūḻki nīril mūḻkiyirukkum pōtu uḷḷē iruppavar peri°kōp (Periscope) eṉṉum karuvi mūlam nīr maṭṭattiluḷḷavaṟṟip pārkkalām.
nīrmūḻku kūṭu: (Bathyspher) itu kaṭalāḻattiṟkuc ceṉṟu aṅkuḷḷa uyir vakikaḷi oḷippaṭam piṭittu ārāycci ceyvataṟkāka villiyam pīpi (Dr.William Beebe)eṉṉum amerikkar payaṉpaṭuttiya uruṇṭi vaṭivāṉa urukku aṟi.
nīrvīḻcci miṉcāra niliyam: (Hydro-Electric Power Station) itu muṟkāla nīr āli (Wind Mill)yiṉ tiruntiya amippu; aṇikkaṭṭu nīrt tēkkaṅkaḷ amittu avaṟṟiṉ nīrvīḻcciyiṉālum,āṟṟunīr vīḻcci yiṉālum cakkaraṅkaḷi iyaṅkac ceytu miṉcāra caktiyi uṟpatti yākkum cakkara amippuḷḷa iyantira niliyam. itaṉik kaṇṭupiṭit tavar pōrṉiraṉ (Beniot Fourneyron) eṉṉum pirāṉciyar (1827).
paṭattanti: paṭaṅkaḷit tantimūlam allatu irēṭiyō mūlam aṉuppu tal. itaṉi kaṇṭupiṭittavar ātar kōṇ (Arthur Korn) eṉṉum cermaṉ viññāṉi (1904)
paracūṭ: kuṭivaṭivāṉa tuṇi; vimāṉattiliruntu kutippavarkaḷ payaṉ paṭuttuvatu. kutikkiṉṟavariṉ pārattiṉāl paracūṭ virintu kāṟṟiṉ taṭuppi atikappaṭuttukiṟatu. oru maṉitaṉik kīḻē koṇṭuvarum paracūṭ 24 aṭi viṭṭamuḷḷatākavirukka vēṇṭum.
pi piḷēṉ: (Biplane) oru iṟakkikku mēl iṉṉoru iṟakkiyuḷḷa vimāṉam.
miṉcāram ākki: (Electric Generator) entira caktiyi miṉcāra caktiyāka māṟṟuṅ karuvi. itu iṭiṉamō eṉavum peyar peṟum itaṉi mutaliṟ ceytavar kirām (Gramme)eṉṉum pirāṉciya poṟivallār (1873). oru kāntattiṉ turuvaṅkaḷiṭiyē uḷḷa parappil oru curuḷ kampi vēkamākac cuḻalvatāl miṉcāram uṇṭākiṟateṉṉum pāraṭē (Faraday) kaṇṭupiṭitta uṇmiyi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭu itu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. itaṉ entira cakti uyarattiliruntu viḻum nīr allatu nīrāvi, allatu eṇṇey entiraṅkaḷāl utavappaṭalām.
miṉkāntam: (Electromagent) oru irumpic cuṟṟi kāppiṭappaṭṭa kampiyic cuṟṟik kampikku miṉ ēṟṟiṉāl irumpu kānta caktiyaṭikiṟatu. miṉ ṉōṭṭam niṉṟavuṭaṉ irumpu kāntat taṉmiyi iḻantu viṭu kiṉṟatu. miṉkānta muṟiyik kaṇṭupiṭittavar āṅkila viññāṉi yākiya i°rūrciyaṉ (Sturgeon) āvar (1820).
miṉcāramaṇi: (Electric Bell) yōcep heṉṟi eṉṉum amerikkarāl 1840il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. irumput tuṇṭoṉṟic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa kampiyil miṉcāram ōṭumpōtu irumpu kāntattaṉmi aṭikiṉṟa teṉṉum uṇmiyi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭu itu kaṇṭupiṭik kappaṭṭatu. oru pottāṉi aḻuttumpōtu miṉcārattiṉ cuṟṟōṭ ṭam oru muṟi muṭivaṭikiṟatu. irumpu kāntattaṉmiyaṭintu maṇiyittaṭṭum cuttiyal pōṉṟa pakutiyuṭiya iṉṉoru irumpi iḻukkiṟatu. cuttiyal maṇiyit taṭṭukiṟatu. avvāṟu aṭikkumpōtu atu oru caṅkuppuri āṇikku veḷiyē vantu miṉcāra ōṭṭatti veṭṭukiṟatu. ākavē maṟupaṭiyum atu paḻiya nilikku varukiṟatu. piṉ kāntattāl iḻukkappaṭṭu maṇiyil taṭṭukiṟatu. ivvāṟu noṭi yil palamuṟi naṭipeṟum. miṉcārattiṉ cuṟṟōṭṭattukku pāṭṭari kaḷi allatu miṉcāra niliyattiliruntu varum miṉcārattip payaṉpaṭuttalām.
miṉcāra viḷakku: miṉ caktiyip palavakikaḷil veḷiccamāka māṟṟalām. (1) vilviḷakku muṟi. hampiriṭēvi (Humpry Davy) iraṇṭu kārpaṉ kaḷil pāyum miṉcāram pirapiyāṉa veḷiccatti uṇṭākkukiṟateṉa 1870il kaṇṭupiṭittār. ivvaki veḷiccaṅkaḷ ippoḻutu ciṉimāppaṭa niḻal vīḻtti(Projectors)kaḷilum turuvu viḷakku(Search light)kaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. (2) miṉcāra palp viḷakku pātaraca āvi nirappappaṭṭa kuḻal viḷakku mutaliyaṉa vēṟu vaki miṉcāra viḷakkukaḷākum.
miṉ mulām pūcutal: (Electroplating) miṉcārattiṉ utaviyāl oru ulōkattukku mēl iṉṉoru ulōkak karivip pūcutal ippeyar peṟum. ivvāṟu ceyyum muṟi iṭēvi (Davy)eṉpavarāl kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. irumpup poruḷkaḷukku melliya veḷḷip paṭalam allatu vēṟu ulōkap paṭalam pūcalām. miṉ ōṭṭam ulōkak karicalkaḷic ciṟu tukaḷkaḷākak koṇṭu ceṉṟu maṭṭamāka oṭṭavikkiṉṟatu.
mikrō pilmpaṭikaḷ: (Microfilm Reproduction) ippoḻutu ariya nūlkaḷ, cācaṉaṅkaḷ, kaṭitaṅkaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟi allatu puttakaṅkaḷ muḻumiyilumuḷḷa pakkaṅkaḷi 35 milli mīṭṭar pilmkaḷāka paṭam piṭittu paṭam kāṭṭum karuviyāl tiriyil viḻac ceytu kāṭṭap paṭukiṉṟaṉa. (milli mīṭṭar 0.40 aṅkulam.)
moṉōṭip entiram: (monotype) moṉōṭip muṟiyil accu kaḷik kōppatum eḻuttukkaḷi vārppatum oru entirattil cey yappaṭuvatilli. inta entirattil eḻuttukkaḷ kuṟitta pottāṉi aḻutta nīṇṭa kākitac curuḷil ovvoru eḻuttukkum cariyāka oru tuvāram ēṟpaṭum. ivvāṟu tuvāraṅkaḷ koṇṭa curuḷi vārpaṭa entirattil māṭṭiviṭṭāl tuvāraṅkaḷukkēṟṟa eḻuttukkaḷit taṉittaṉiyē vārttu vari variyākat takkapaṭi cērttuk koṇṭu varum.
moṉō piḷēṉ: (Monoplane) oru cōṭi (pakkattukkovvoru) iṟakkiyuṭiya vimāṉam.
mōṭṭār vaṇṭi: peṭrōl entirattiṉāl ōṭṭappaṭum mōṭṭār vaṇṭi cīk piriṭ mākku° (Siegfried Marcus) eṉṉum vīyaṉṉāvāci yāl 1875il ōṭṭappaṭṭatu; 10 āṇṭukaḷ kaḻittu kotliyap timiḷar (Gottlib Daimler) eṉṉum poṟivallār mutal mōṭṭār cikkiḷic ceytār.
mōr° kōṭ: (Morse Code) mōr° eṉṉum amerikkarāl 1838il tanti pēcuvataṟku vakukkappaṭṭa kuṟṟum, kīṟu maṭaṅkiya kuṟiyīṭukaḷ.
makira°kōp: (Microscope) aṇuperukki (pūtakkaṇṇāṭi) eṉṉum itu ciṟiya poruḷkaḷi 2,000 maṭaṅku peruppittuk kāṭṭak kūṭiya karuvi. itaṉi hāṉ°, yāṉ ceṉ (Hans and Janssen) eṉṉum iraṇṭu ollāntu vācikaḷ 1590-l kaṇṭupiṭittārkaḷ.
yeṭ eñciṉ: (Jet Engine) ākāca vāṉam mēlē eḻumputal, tuppākki veṭikkumpōtu piṉpuṟam taḷḷutal eṉṉum koḷkiyi aṭip paṭiyākak koṇṭu amikkappaṭṭa vimāṉa entiram. viṭṭiḷ (Sir Frank Whittle) eṉpavarāl 1930il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. 1941mutal ivvaki entira amippuḷḷa vimāṉaṅkaḷ vaḻaṅkukiṉṟaṉa. iv ventiram muṉ pakutiyiṉāl kāṟṟi uṟiñci nerukki eriporuḷ kaḷōṭu kalantu erintu uṇṭākum virinta vāyuvip piṉpuṟattiṉuḷḷa kūmpiya kuḻāy vaḻiyākat taḷḷukiṟatu. ākācavāṇam vāyuvik kīḻē taḷḷa atu eppaṭi mēlē eḻumpukiṟatō atē pōl ituvum vimāṉatti mēlē taḷḷukiṟatu.
vākkam kiḷīṉar: (Vacuum cleaner) itu vīṭṭuttari, taḷapāṭaṅkaḷ, kampaḷam mutaliyavaṟṟip kāṟṟōṭu tūciyi iḻuttuc cuttañ ceyyum entiram. itu kāṟṟi iḻukkum kuḻāy miṉcārattiṉāl vēli ceykiṟatu. itu cicil pūt (Cecil Booth) eṉṉum āṅkilarāl 1901il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
vākkam puṭṭi: itu uṇavukaḷ tiravap poruḷkaḷi vippataṟkuḷḷa puṭṭi; kuḷiri allatu veppatti atikam iḻukkātapaṭi kāppāṟṟu vatu. itaṉ pakkaṅkaḷ iṭiyē veḷiyuḷḷa iraṇṭu kaṇṇāṭic cuvarkaḷālāṉavi. iṭiyēyuḷḷa veḷik kāṟṟakaṟṟappaṭṭu veṟṟiṭa mākavirukkum. itaṉi cēr yēm° tivār (Sir James Dewar) eṉṉum i°kottiya viññāṉi 1896il kaṇṭupiṭittār.
vāyuviḷakku: (Gaslight) nilakkari vāyuvi viḷakkiṉāl erikkum muṟiyik kaṇṭupiṭittavar villiyam mārṭok (William Mardock). ivar itaṉi 1792il taṉatu vīṭṭil payaṉpaṭuttiṉār. pattu āṇṭukaḷiṉ piṉ itu ilaṇṭaṉ vītikaḷil viḷakkukaḷukkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭatu. 19ām nūṟṟāṇṭil ituvē ceyaṟki veḷiccamākap payaṉpaṭṭatu. 1855il puṉceṉ (Bunsen) eṉṉum cērmaṉ viññāṉi viḷakkuk kāyi (Burner) kaṇṭupiṭittār. itiyiruntu veḷoḷi koṭukkum valit tuṇittiri (Mantle) kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
vimāṉam: (Aeroplane) kāṟṟilum pāraṅkūṭiya paṟakkum cātaṉam; uḷ eri entiram allatu ‘yeṭ’entirattiṉāliyaṅkuvatu. ivvaki vimā ṉatti mutalil paṟakkac ceytavarkaḷ, or villi (Orville), vilpar iriṭ (Wilbur Wright) eṉṉum iru amerikka cakōtararkaḷ. 1903il itaṉip paṟakkaviṭṭapōtu itu 12 viṉāṭikaḷ paṟantatu. ippoḻutu cila vimāṉaṅkaḷ oli cellum vēkattil (maṇikku 760 mil) paṟak kiṉṟaṉa. 100 pērik koṇṭu cellakkūṭiya irāṇuva vimāṉaṅkaḷum pirayāṇi vimāṉaṅkaḷumuḷḷaṉa.
veppamāṉi: veppatti aḷakkum karuvi. veppamāṉi aḷavil pāraṉ hēyiṭ, ceṉṭikirēṭ eṉṉum iruvaki aḷavikaḷ vaḻaṅkum. pāraṉ hēyiṭ aḷaviyil paṉikkaṭṭi urukum nili 320. taṇṇīr kotikkum nili 2120. ceṇṭikirēṭṭil uṟiyum nili 00 koti nili 1000.
ulōkam
accu ulōkam: (Type metal) aṇṭimaṇiyōṭu kārīyamum veḷḷīyamum kalanta ulōkam (kārīyam 60%, aṇṭimaṉi, 30%,veḷḷīyam 10%).
aṇṭimaṉi: (Antimony) oru vaki nīla veḷḷi ulōkam. nīrilum pārkka 6.7 maṭaṅku pāramāṉatu. kuḷirumpōtu curuṅkuvataṟkup patil viriyum taṉmiyuḷḷatu. itu accu eḻuttu vārkkum ulōkattuṭaṉ kalappa taṟkum vēṟu vārppu ulōkak kalavikaḷōṭu kalappataṟkum payaṉ paṭukiṟatu.
alumiṉiyam: veṇmiyāṉa turu vēṟāta ilēcāṉa ulōkam. itaṉ pāram irumpiṉ pārattil 1/3 paṅkākum. itu perumpālum camiyaṟ pāttiraṅkaḷ ceyyavum vārppup poruḷkaḷ cey yavum payaṉpaṭu kiṟatu. itu vēṟu ulōkaṅkaḷōṭu kalantu vimāṉa uṟuppukkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu. ayarlāntu, pirāṉcu, vaṭa āppirikkā, kiḻak kintiyat tīvukaḷ, kaṉaṭā, uruciyā, intiyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷiṟ kiṭik kiṉṟatu.
iracak kalavi: (Amalgum) pātaracattōṭu vēṟoru ulōkañ cērnta kalavi. veḷḷi, taṅka maṇṇil avvulōkaṅkaḷ iracattik koṇṭu piritteṭukkappaṭum. iracam ivvulōkat tūḷkaḷōṭu cērntu iracak kalaviyāka māṟukiṟatu. itaṉic cūṭākkumpōtu iracam āviyāka māṟip pōyviṭa ulōkat tūḷkaḷ taṅkukiṉṟaṉa.
irumpu: maṉitaṉukku vēṇṭiya ulōkap poruḷkaḷil mika mukkiya māṉatu. itil vārp pirumpu, tēṉirumpu, eḵku eṉa mūṉṟu pirivuka ḷuṇṭu. vārppirumpil 4% kārpaṉ uḷḷatu. itu kaṭiṉamāṉataṉṟu, eḷitil uṭiyak kūṭiyatu.kaṉi irumpil kārpaṉ kuṟivāka virukkum. itu kāyccit taṭṭa ēṟṟatu. eḵku allatu urukku eṉpatu irumpum kārpaṉuṅkoṇṭa kalavi. itil kari 1.7% aḷavilirukkum. itu mikak kaṭiṉamāṉatu; kārpaṉē itaṟkuk kāraṇam.
iṉvar: (Invart) nikkalum urukkum kalanta kalavi. itaṉ veppap perukkam mikak kuṟivāka viruppatāl itu peṇṭulaṅkaḷilum, kaṭikāraṅ kaḷilum aḷavu karuvikaḷilum payaṉākiṟatu. cārla° killōm (Charles Giallume) itaṉik kaṇṭupiṭittār.
kalappu ulōkaṅkaḷ: (Alloy) vayiramēṟa allatu metuvaṭiya oṉṟōṭu oṉṟu kalantu urukkappaṭṭa ulōkaṅkaḷ kalappu ulōkaṅkaḷākum.
turuvēṟāta eḵku: (Stinless steel) urukkōṭu kurōmiyaṅkalanta kalavi. itu kaṟukkātu. paḷapaḷappāka virukkum. itu perumpālum pāttira vakikaḷ ceyyappayaṉpaṭukiṟatu. cattira vittiyattukku vēṇṭiya karuvikaḷum itaṉāṟ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
pāriyam: oru ulōt taṉimam. itu varṇak kittoḻilukkum cāyaṅkaḷ (Paints) ceyvataṟkum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.
veṇkalam: cempum veḷḷīyamuṅ kalanta kalavi. cempōṭu a tika veḷḷīyattik kalanta kalavi (30-40%) i°pekkulam ulōkam (Speculum Metal) eṉavum,veṇkalattōṭu ciṟitu nākattik cērttuc ceyyum kalavi tuppākki veṇkalam (Gun Metal) eṉavumpaṭum.
iracāyaṉam viññāṉam mutaliyaṉa
akar: (Ager) kiḻakku nāṭukaḷiluḷḷa cenniṟak kaṭaṟpāci oṉṟiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum pacipōṉṟa oru poruḷ. itu niliyāṉa vaṭivamil lāta poruḷāyiruppiṉum teḷivāṉa tōṟṟamuḷḷatu. itu tūḷāka allatu kaṭṭiyākak kaṭikaḷiṟ kiṭikkum. itu nīri atikam uṭ koṇṭu perukkiṟatu; vennīril eḷitiṟ karikiṟatu. uṇavilum pala vaki miṭṭāykaḷilum pāliliruntu ceyyappaṭum poruḷkaḷilum itu cērkkappaṭukiṟatu.
aciṭṭik amilam: (Acetic Acid) itu muṟkālam mutal kāṭi eṉṉum peyariṉāl aṟiyappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itu viṉākiriyilum vēṟu pala poruḷkaḷilumiruntum ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. itu perumpālum uṇavup poruḷkaḷik keṭāmal pātukākkum muṟikaḷukkum, ceyaṟkip paṭṭuc ceyvataṟkum vēṟu palavakikaḷukkum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. itu uṭaliṟpaṭṭāl tōlip puṇṇākkum.
aciṭṭōṉ (Acetone): itu marattiliruntu vaṭitteṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. nīriḻivu nōyāḷiyiṉ ciṟu nīril cila camayaṅkaḷil itu kāṇappaṭuva tuṇṭu. cellulō°, niṭrēṭṭu, koḻuppukkaḷ, piḷā°ṭikkukaḷ, aciṭṭilīṉ mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ karippāṉāka itu utavukiṟatu.
aṇu: aṇuveṉpatu mēṟkoṇṭu pirikkamuṭiyāta mika nuṇṇiya caṭap poruḷiṉ kūṟu. aṇuviṉ naṭuvil oru karuvum karuvic cuṟṟi ilekṭrāṉkaḷumuṇṭu. karuviluḷḷa miṉcāra caktikku ataṉic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ellā elakrāṉkaḷiṉ miṉcāra cakti camamāka irukkum. karuvic cuṟṟi irelakrāṉkaḷ kirakaṅkaḷippōlac cuṟṟivantu koṇṭirukkum. ellāt taṉi aṇukkaḷi uṭittālum orēvaki miṉ catti veḷiyākiṟatu.
aṇuniṟi: (Atomic Weight) oru taṉimattiṉ aṇuviṟkum oru tiṭṭat taṉimattiṉ aṇuviṟkumuḷḷa oppu niṟi ataṉ aṇuniṟi eṉap paṭum. ākciciṉ aṇu niṟi 16.0000 eṉakkoṇṭu aṇu niṟikaḷ kuṟikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉpaṭi hiṭiracaṉ aṇuviṉ niṟi 1.0080.
aṇucakti: aṇukkaḷi veṟuṅkaṇṇiṉāl pārkka muṭiyātu. in nuṇ ṇiya aṇukkaḷi viññāṉa muṟiyiṉāl piḷantāl aḷaviṭa muṭiyāta miṉcatti veḷivarukiṉṟatu. ik koḷkiyip piṉpaṟṟi aṇukuṇṭu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. ic caktiyi aḻivu vēlikkup payaṉ paṭuttuvatu pōlavē ākka vēlikkum payaṉpaṭuttalām.
aṇṭicepṭikku: (Antiseptics) puṇṇi allatu kāyattik kaḻuvik kaṭṭiṉāl tīya pākṭīriyākkaḷ perukāmal taṭukkum maruntu.
attar: urōcāppū itaḻkaḷit taṇṇīriliṭṭu vālivaṭi ceytapiṉ mēlē mitakkum eṇṇeyp poruḷ. 340 urōcāp pūviliruntu oru iṟāttal itaḻ kiṭikkum. itiliruntu iraṇṭu tuḷi attar kiṭikkum. palkēriyā, pirāṉcu, ciriyā, īrāṉ, turukki, intiyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷil urōcā payiriṭappaṭukiṟatu. attar mukkiya vācaṉip poruḷ.
apiṉi: kacakacāc ceṭiyiṉ iḷaṅkāyik kīṟi vaṭiyum pāli eṭuttu ularttic cērkkappaṭuvatu apiṉi eṉappaṭum. pāracīkam, intiyā, turukki, yukō cilāvākkiyā, māciṭōṉiyā, palkēriyā, cīṉā, āciyāmiṉar mutaliya nāṭukaḷil itu eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. apiṉiyi uṭkoṇṭāl mayakkamuṇṭākum.
amilaṅkaḷ: (Acids) oruvaki iracāyaṉap poruḷkaḷ. iliṭma° (Litmas) eṉṉum cāyatti nīlattiliruntu civappākkak kūṭiyavi. puḷippāṉa cuviyuṭiyavi. ivaṟṟil hiṭiraciṉum vēṟu oṉṟiraṇṭu taṉimaṅ kaḷum kalantirukkum. itaṉi uppākkuvataṟku hiṭiraciṉukkup patil oru ulōkattip piratiyīṭu ceyyalām. hiṭiraciṉukkup patil nākattic cērttāl nākacalpiṭṭu uṇṭākum. calparik, niṟṟik, hiṭirōkuḷōrik amilaṅkaḷ arikkum taṉmiyuṭiyaṉa. ciṟṟik, tārtārik, acaṟṟik amilaṅkaḷ uṇavukaḷ carikkaṭṭuvataṟkum, pāṉa vakikaḷukkum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. kārpalik amilam mika upayōkamāṉa kirumi nācaṉi.
appirakam: ulōka vakikaḷiloṉṟu. itu kaṇṇāṭi pōṉṟu, takaṭāka uṭittu eṭukkakkūṭiyatu. itil oruvaki oḷiyip pukaviṭum. itu nekiḻvum mīḷ caktiyumuṭiya tiṇmam: intiyāvilum ilaṅkiyi lum kiṭikkiṟatu. mañcaḷ, pacci, civappu, paḻuppu, kaṟuppu niṟaṅkaḷuṭi yavi uṇṭu. oḷiyip pukaviṭun taṉmiyum, tīyi etirkkun tiṟaṉum veppanili māṟṟaṅkaḷāl pātikkappaṭāta taṉmiyumuṭiya itu aṭuppukaḷilum viḷakkukaḷilum, caṉṉal katavukaḷilum,mōṭṭār vaṇṭikaḷiṉ muṉ tirikaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟatu.
ampar: (Amber) kōṭikkaṇakkāṉa āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉ uyiruḷḷa maraṅkaḷiliruntu vaṭinta piciṉkaḷ nilattuḷ kiṭantu mañcaṭ paḻuppu niṟamāka māṟiyuḷḷaṉa. ivi ampar eṉappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ampar pālṭik kaṭaṟ pakutikaḷiṟ kiṭikkiṟatu. ampar poṭi ceytu merukeṇṇey kaḷilum cāyaṅkaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.
ampar: (Ambergris) itu orkkōli, mīṉampar eṉavum paṭum. itu i°pēm timiṅkilattiṉ kuṭaliliruntu varum meḻuku pōṉṟa poruḷ. itu cila camayaṅkaḷil kaḻivup poruḷākat timiṅkilattiṉ vayiṟṟiṉiṉṟu vantu nīril mitantu koṇṭirukkum. itu vācaṉip poruḷkaḷ ceyyappayaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
ammippāl kuttutal: māṭṭammip pāli viññāṉa muṟiyil payaṉpaṭuttuvatik kaṇṭupiṭittavar āṅkila vittiyar eṭvārṭṭu ceṉṉar (1749 - 1823). ip pāl kuttappaṭṭavarukkup periyammi uṇṭākātu. amminōy oruvaki viracāl uṇṭākiṟatu.
ammōṉiyā: (Ammonia) niṭraciṉ, hiṭraciṉ campantamāṉa kalavi; itu kāṟṟilum pātikaṉaṅ kuṟintatu; nīril kariyak kūṭiyatu. uṟiyum nilikkuc ciṟitu kūṭiya veppa niliyuḷḷa nīr 1,150 kaṉaaḷavu am mōṉiya vāyuvik kalantu koḷḷum. ik kalavi tirava ammō ṉiyā eṉappaṭum.
ayōṭiṉ: (Iodine) itu kaṭaṟṟāvaraṅkaḷilum, veṭiyuppu kaṉiyaṅkaḷi liruntum peṟappaṭum karunīlamāṉa paṭikam. itu maruntu vaki kaḷukkum cāyaṅkaḷukkum payaṉākiṉṟatu.
arkaṉ: (Argon) kāṟṟil kāṇappaṭum vāyu. itu vēṟet taṉimaṅkaḷōṭum cēramāṭṭātu.
alaṅkārap poruḷkaḷ: vācaṉit tilaṅkaḷ, vācaṉip pacikaḷ, mukappoṭikaḷ, mukappacikaḷ itaḻc cāyam, kaṉṉac cāyam, nakameruku, puruva mi, paṟpaci, mayirnīkki mutaliyaṉa.
alkahāl: (Alcohol) itu cātāraṇamāka carkkari allatu i°ṭārccōṭu ī°ṭṭik kalantu notikka viṭuvatāl kiṭikkiṟatu. uviṉ, pīyar pōṉṟa kuṭivakikaḷil veṟiyi uṇṭākkum poruḷ alkahāl eṉappaṭum. itu nalla karippāṉ (Solvent); itu merukeṇṇeyk kum (vāṇiṣ) maruntukaḷukkum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum.
ampumeṉ: (Albumen) itu oruvakip purōṭṭiṉ (Protein); nīril kariyak kūṭiyatu. ivvakiyiloṉṟu muṭṭiyiṉ veṇkaru. itu veppam, amilam, alkahāl campantamāṉāl kaṭṭiyākum.
aṉiliṉ (Aniline): itu nilakkarit tāriliruntu eṭukkappaṭum peṉciṉ (Benzene) eṉṉum tiravattiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum niṟamaṟṟa eṇṇeyp poruḷ. palavakic ceyaṟkic cāyam ceyvataṟku itu payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
ā°piriṉ: cācilik amilam eṉṟa iracāyaṉap poruḷ. vāṇipattil ā°piriṉ eṉa vaḻaṅkiṉṟatu. itu talivali, kāyccal, taṭimaṉ mutaliya nōykaḷukku maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
iracavātam: (Alchemy) itu paḻaṅkāla iracāyaṉa muṟi. itu tāḻnta ulōka vakikaḷit taṅkamāka māṟṟuvatum uṭali yaḻiyāmalirukkac ceyvatumākiya maruntik kaṇṭupiṭippataṟku muṟkālattavar ceytu vanta ārāycci muṟikaḷ. ivvaki ārāycci maruntuc carakkukaḷi erippatum avaṟṟip piṟitoṉṟōṭu kalappatumākiya taṉmika ḷuṭiyatāka viruntatu. immuṟikaḷē ikkāla iracāyaṉa cāttirat tikku vaḻikāṭṭiyākavuḷḷaṉa.
ilippacci: itu tāvaraṅkaḷiṟkāṇum pacci niṟapporuḷ. pacci niṟamuḷḷa tāvaraṅkaḷ itaṉutaviyāl cūriya oḷiyiluḷḷa caktiyik koṇṭu nīriyum kārpaṉ ṭi yākciṭṭiyum kūṭṭic carkkari ākiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷic camittuk koḷḷum. icceyal oḷic cērkki eṉappaṭum.
iṉculiṉ: (Inisulin) itu irippikkuk kīḻuḷḷa cavviliruntu curakkum oruvaki iracāyaṉa nīr. ipporuḷ curakkā viṭṭāl carkkari aḷavukku miñci irattattil ōṭic ciṟunīrccurappikaḷ vaḻiyāka mūttirattil veḷic ceṉṟuviṭum; nīriḻivu nōyuṇṭākum. āṭumāṭu, paṉṟi mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ iṉculiṉ ataṟku maruntākiṟatu. ataṉi ūcikuttic celuttuvārkaḷ.
ūtuvatti: vācaṉipporuḷ, marattūḷ eṉpavi kalantu ceyyappaṭum kuccukaḷ. cātāraṇa ūtuvattiyil 30% cantaṉat tūḷum 20% akil marattūḷum, 5% kiccilik kiḻaṅkum, 5% veṭṭivērum, 10% mēṟ kuṟippiṭṭa ilikaḷum pūkkaḷum, 20% paṟaṅkic cāmpirāṇiyum 10% kariyum piṟaporuḷkaḷumuṇṭu. uyarntavaki vattikaḷukku ampar, vācaṉit tilaṅkaḷ, ka°tūri, puṉuku mutaliya poruḷkaḷum cērum.
oṭṭuvarṇam: (Distemper) vaccirappaci, taṇṇīr, cīmic cuṇṇāmpu ākiyavaṟṟik kalantu ceyyappaṭum kalavi. taṭitta paci allatu tūḷvaṭivil oṭṭu varṇam viṟkappaṭukiṟatu.
oppaṭartti: (Specific gravity) oru poruḷiṉ niṟikkum atē parumaṉ koṇṭa 40 veppaniliyiluḷḷa nīriṉ niṟikkumuḷḷa vikitam. tiravap poruḷkaḷukku nīr ittakiya tiṭapporuḷākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. vāyuviṉ aṭarttiṟku mutalil hiṭiraciṉuṭaṉ oppiṭappaṭṭatu. ippoḻutu itu ākcicaṉuṭaṉ oppiṭappaṭukiṟatu.
oḷiccērkki: (Photosynthesis) paccit tāvaraṅkaḷ tam ili mutaliya uṟuppukaḷiluḷḷa pacciyam eṉṉum niṟamiyiṉ utaviyiṉāl cūriya veḷiccattiṉiṉṟum peṟum caktiyik koṇṭu nīriyum kariyamila vāyuviyum kūṭṭic carkkari allatu māppaṇṭamākiya kārpō hiṭirēṭṭu eṉṉum poruḷit tokukkum ceyal. oḷiyiṉ ceya lāl poruḷkaḷ tokukkappaṭutaliṉ icceyal oḷiccērkki eṉappaṭukiṟatu.
oṭikkalōṉ: (Eau de Cologne) vācaṉiyuḷḷa tiravap poruḷ. kolōṉ (ittāli) eṉṉumiṭattil ceyyap paṭuvatāl itaṟku oṭikkalōṉ eṉṉum peyar vaḻaṅkukiṉṟatu. cuttamāṉa matuccāram (alkahāl) maruntuc carakkukaḷ, cila naṟumaṇapporuḷkaḷ, mūlikikaḷ malarkaḷik kāyccik kiyāḷam ceytu vāli vaṭittup piṉ takka aḷavil pala tāvarac carakkukaḷiyum kalantu itu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu.
kālari: (Colorie) 100 kirām (2.2 pavuṇṭu) taṇṇīriṉ veppatti oru ceṇṭikirēṭṭu pāki uyarttum veppattiṉ aḷavu. itu pala vaki uṇavukaḷ uṭalil erivatāl uṇṭākum caktiyiṉ aḷavi alaku.
kāṟṟu: itu pala vāyukkaḷiṉ tokuppu. itil 78% niṭṭiraciṉ, 21% ārkaṉ, kārpaṉ ṭi okciṭ 0.03% nīrāvi mutaliyaṉa uṇṭu. paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷukku aṇmiyil itil karit tūcu, kantaka amilam, hiṭṭiraciṉ calpiṭṭu mutaliyaṉa kāṇappaṭum. kāṟṟu pūmiyic cūḻntirukkiṟatu. kāṟṟu iyaṅ kuvatāl atu vīcukiṟatu.
kirumi kollikaḷ: (Anticeptics) nōykaḷi uṇṭākkuvaṉavum, cuttattik keṭuppaṉavumākiya nuṇkirumikaḷik kollum poruḷ. ivi kāyaṅkaḷik kaḻuvutal, cattira cikicci ceyyum karuvikaḷ tuṇikaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟiluḷḷa kirumikaḷik kollutal pōṉṟavaṟ ṟukkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum. porācik tūḷ (Borocic Powder), hiṭ ṭiraciṉ parekciṭ, ilicol, kārpalik amilam mutaliyaṉa peritum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
koḻuppu: itu tāvaraṅkaḷilum, vilaṅkukaḷ paṟavikaḷilum tōlukkuk kīḻirukkum. maṉitaṉiṭattil itu potuvāka eṅkuñ cērntirukkum. oṭṭakaṅkaḷukku itu mutukut tiraṇiyāka virukkum. tāvaraṅkaḷiṉ koḻuppu eṇṇeyākak kiṭikkiṟatu. maṟṟa uṇavukaḷilum pārkka eṇṇeyuṇavil atika caktiyuṇṭu.
kōppi maṇ: (Porcelin) itu ulōkak kalappillāta veḷḷik kaḷimaṇ. immaṇṇiṉāl ceyyappaṭum pāttiraṅkaḷ cīṉap pāt tiraṅkaḷ eṉappaṭum. cīṉāvukkuc ceṉṟu mīṇṭa pirayāṇikaḷ koṇṭu ceṉṟa pāttiraṅkaḷiyum maṇṇiyum koṇṭu airōppiyar itaṉi aṟintaṉar. cīṉakkaḷi pōṉṟa maṇṇi mutalil airōppāvil tayārittavar potkar (Bottger) eṉṉum cermāṉiyar (1710.)
cīmic cuṇṇāmpu: (Chalk) kaṭaṟ pirāṇikaḷiṉ ōṭukaḷiliruntu uṇṭāṉa cuṇṇāmpu. iṅkilāntil pala cōkku malikaḷuṇṭu. ivi aintu kōṭi āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉ kaṭaluṭ paṭinta kaṭaṟpirāṇikaḷiṉ oṭukaḷi liruntu uṇṭāṉavi.
ceyaṟki nūlkaḷ: tāvarap poruḷkaḷiluḷḷa cellulōci aṭippaṭi yākak koṇṭu ceyyappaṭum ceyaṟki nūlkaḷ mutalil tōṉṟiṉa. ivi maṟuvaḷarccic collulō° iḻikaḷ(regenerated celuose fibers) eṉappaṭum. irāyaṉ (rayon) eṉpatu ivaṟṟiṉ potup peyar. kaḻivup paṭṭik karittu akkariviliruntu nūlkaḷit tayārikkum muṟi cermaṉiyilum yappāṉilum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟatu. tāvara allatu vilaṅkup poruḷkaḷallāta tokuppup poruḷkaḷiliruntu cey yappaṭum nūl nilāṉ eṉa vaḻaṅkukiṟatu. kaṇṇāṭiyiliruntum irappariliruntum nūlkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. pāliluḷḷa kēcīṉ eṉṉum puroṭṭiṉiliruntum nūlkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivi amerikkāvil arlāk (Arlac) eṉavum, ittāliyil ilāṉiṭṭāl (Lanidal) eṉavum vaḻaṅkiṉṟaṉa. cōyā avariyiliruntum nilak kaṭaliyiliruntum ikkālattil tokuppu nūlkaḷ ceyyappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa.
paṭṭu: cila pūccikaḷ puḻupparuva muḻu vaḷarcciyaṭinta piṉ tammuṭalic cuṟṟi melliya nūli nūṟṟuk kūṭukaṭṭik koḷkiṉṟaṉa. puḻukkaḷiṉ talippākattiluḷḷa iru curappikaḷiliruntu varum nīr kāṟṟuppaṭṭa vuṭaṉ keṭṭiyāṉa nūlākiṉṟatu. ikkūṭukaḷiliruntu nūlik kulit teṭuttu āṭikaḷ neyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
pīyar: (beer) vāḷi muḷiyik notikka vittuc ceyyappaṭum oruvaki matuvaki.
piḷā°ṭik: (Plastics) palavakip poruḷkaḷiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum ceyaṟkip paciyiliruntu peṟappaṭum poruḷ. itiliruntu mikap pala poruḷkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.cellulōyiṭ eṉṉum poruḷi mutaliṟ ceyyak kaṇṭupiṭittavar parmiṅkāmil vāḻnta alekcāntar park° (Alexander Parkes-1855). maṇṇeṇṇey, maṇilākkoṭṭi, pāl, nilakkari, maram mutaliya pala poruḷkaḷ piḷā°ṭikkāka māṟṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. nilāṉ tuṇikaḷ, cīppukaḷ, teli pōṉkaḷ, pilmkaḷ mutaliya palaporuḷkaḷ itaṉāṟ ceyyap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
peṉiciliṉ: (Peniclin) palavaki nōykaḷik kuṇappaṭuttap payaṉ paṭuttappaṭum mikap payaṉuḷḷa maruntu. itu cilavaki nuṇ kirumi kaḷip perukāmal taṭukkiṟatu. itu oruvaki pūñcak kāḷāṉiliruntu ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu.
peṉciṉ: (Benzene) nilakkarit tāriliruntu eṭukkappaṭum niṟamillāta tiravam. itil irappar, piciṉ, koḻuppu mutaliyaṉa kariyum. cāyaṅ kaḷum vēṟu pala poruḷkaḷum ceyvataṟku itu payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
mayir: itu pālūṭṭikaḷiṉ uṭaliṉ paraviyirukkum. itu tōliṉmītu oraḷavu kāṟṟip piṭittu vittu uṭaliṉ veppaniliyik kāppāṟ ṟum. kāṟṟu veppatti eḷitaṟ kaṭattāp poruḷkaḷuḷoṉṟu.
veṭimaruntu: veṭiyuppu, marakkari, kantakam eṉpavaṟṟiṉ kalavi. cīṉar itip paḻaṅkālattilēyē payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. itaṉi airōppāvil ceyyak kaṇṭupiṭittavar cermaṉ tuṟavi (Monk) icvāṭ° (Schwartz). veṭimaruntu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum pala vēlikaḷukku ippoḻutu iṭiṉameṭ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.
kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ uruvac cilikaḷ mutaliyaṉa
irāmcēciṉ periya uruvac cili: (Colossi of Rameses II) ekiptiya araca ṉākiya iraṇṭām irāmcēciṉ nāṉku uruvaṅkaḷ irukkum vaṭivil maṇ kallil ki.mu.1270il veṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. ivi nil āṟṟiṉ iṭatu kariyiluḷḷa apucāmvel eṉṉum kōyiliṉ pakutikaḷāka vuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟiṉ uyaram 70 aṭi.
ī°ṭar tīvu uruvac cilikaḷ: teṉ pacipik kaṭaliluḷḷa ī°ṭar tīvukaḷil uruvac cilikaḷ pala nari niṟakkaṟkaḷil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟi eccātik kuriyavarkaḷ veṭṭiṉārkaḷ eṉṟu aṟiya muṭiyavilli. ī°ṭar tīvu teṉṉamerikkāviluḷḷa cilli nāṭṭiliruntu mēṟkē 2,000 mil toliviluḷḷatu. ivvuruvac cilikaḷ 4 aṭi mutal 37 aṭi uyaramuṭiyaṉa. ivi 200 mutal 300 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷa mēṭikaḷ mītu vikkappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa.
urōṭ° tīviṉ periya uruvac cili (Colossus of Rhodes): urōṭ° tīvil urōṭ° tuṟimukattil ki.mu. 280il niṟuttappaṭṭa 103 aṭi uyaramuḷḷa veṇkalac cili. itu kirēkkariṉ cūriyakkaṭavuḷākiya helō° kaṭavuḷik kuṟippatu. ki.mu. 224il nērnta pūmi atircci yiṉpōtu itu viḻuntatu. iṉṉoru periya uruvac cili nīrō (Nero) aracaṉuṭiyatu. itu 110 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu; urōmil niṟuttap paṭṭatu.
urōm nakariṉ cēyiṉṭ pīṟṟar ālayam: itu ittāliyiṉ talinakarāṉa urōmiluḷḷatu; kiṟittuva tēvālayaṅkaḷ ellāvaṟṟilum periyatu. itu 18,000 catura aṭi parappi mūṭik kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itu iraṇṭām yūliya° eṉṉum pōppiṉ kālattil 1,450il toṭaṅki 1632il muṭikkappaṭṭatu. itaṉ nīḷam 6,336 aṭi; uyaram 435 aṭi; uḷḷēyuḷḷa palipīṭattiṉ uyaram 95 aṭi. itu 54,000 pēr niṉṟu vaṇaṅkuvataṟku iṭamaḷikkak kūṭiyatu. 
ekiptiya piramiṭṭuc camātikaḷ: (Pyramids of Egypt) ivi nīla natiyiṉ mēṟkuk kariyil kicē (Gizesh) eṉṉumiṭattil toṭaṅki aṟupatu mil tūrattil paravik kiṭakkiṉṟaṉa.ivi ki.mu.3500 mutal ki.mu.1800 vari parōvā eṉappaṭṭa aracariṉ uṭalkaḷi aṭakkañceyvataṟkuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa kallaṟikaḷ. kirēkkarkaḷāl kuvu eṉappaṭṭa ciyap° (Cheops) aracaṉāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa camāti. 450 aṭi uyaramum taḷattil 746 aṭi caturamumuḷḷatu. itu 13 ēkkar nilatti mūṭi niṟkiṉṟatu. itu 2,300,000kku mēṟpaṭṭa nīlak kaṟpāṟikaḷāṟ kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
epuceciluḷḷa tayaṉā ālayam: (Temple at Diana at Epueses) āciyā miṉaril epuce° eṉṉumiṭattil ayōṉiyarāl ki.mu.5ām nūṟ ṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyil. itu 425 aṭi nīḷamum 225 aṭi akala mum uṭiyatāka viruntatu. kūriyit tāṅkiya tūṇ ovvoṉṟum 60 aṭi uyaramum 150 toṉ eṭiyumuḷḷaṉa.
empayar °ṭēṭpilṭiṅ: (Empire State Building) niyuyōk paṭṭiṉatti luḷḷatu. itaṉ uyaram 1,250 aṭi. itaṟku 102 māṭikaḷuṇṭu. ituvē ulakil mika uyarnta kaṭṭaṭam. itu 1931il muṭikkappaṭṭatu. 86vatu māṭiyiliruntu pārttāl 25mil toliviluḷḷa kāṭcikaḷ tōṉṟum.
olimpa°malic ciya° uruvaccili: (Statue of Zeus at Olympus) ki.mu. 4ām nūṟṟāṇṭil piṭiya° amitta ciya° kaṭavuḷariṉ uruvaccili olimpa° maliyil vikkappaṭṭiruntatu. itu calavik kal, tantam, poṉ mutaliyavikaḷāl ceyyappaṭṭu 58 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatāka viruntatu. itaṉ cimmācaṉam pala maṇikaḷāl alaṅkarikkappaṭ ṭiruntatu. icciliyik kiṟittuva paṭi eṭuppāḷar aḻittaṉar.
kalikkār nācaciṉ camāti: (Mausoleum of Halicarnassus) peṭram (Bedrum) eṉappaṭum kalikkār nācacil (āciyā miṉar) ārtimiciyā eṉṉum irāṇi taṉatu kaṇavaṉ moca lōcacukku ki.mu.352il calavik kaṟ camāti oṉṟu kaṭṭiṉāḷ. itu 140 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu. itu 12ām nūṟ ṟāṇṭilum, 15ām nūṟṟāṇṭilum nērnta pūmi atircciyil aḻintu pōyiṟṟu.
kūvar aṇikkaṭṭu (Hoover Damd): itu pōlṭarṭām eṉavum vaḻaṅkum. itu kolaraṭō āṟṟiṉ aricōṉāvilum nevēṭāvilumuḷḷatu. ivvaṇikkaṭṭiṉ uyaram 727 aṭi; nīḷam 1180 aṭi. itu pattuk kōṭi kalaṉ nīr piṭikkak kūṭiyatu; 1935-l tiṟakkappaṭṭatu. itu ulakil mikapperiya aṇikkaṭṭu. 4,400,000 kaṉa yār (kacam) kāṉ kirīṭ itik kaṭṭap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
cāntā cōpiyāp paḷḷivācal: (Mosque of Santa Sophia) ya°tiṉiyaṉ (Justinian)eṉṉum cakkaravarttiyāl 6ām nūṟṟāṇṭil koṉ°tānti ṉōppiḷil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kaṭṭaṭamoṉṟuḷḷatu. iraṇṭām mukamatu eṉṉum turukkic cultāṉ in nakarip piṭittapōtu avaṉ ataṉip paḷḷi vācalāka māṟṟiṉāṉ (1453). itaṉ uṭpuṟaṅkaḷ cuvar oviyaṅka ḷālum calavik kaṟkaḷālum alaṅkarikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. mattiya kummaṭṭam 108 aṭi uyaramum 107 aṭi viṭṭamumuḷḷatu.
cīṉap peruñcuvar: (Great wall of China) kallālum maṇṇālum kaṭṭi veḷiyē ceṅkal aḻuttappaṭṭa 1,400 mil nīṇṭa cuvar. itu cīṉā vukkum maṅkōliyāvukkum elliyākavuḷḷatu. itik kaṭṭum vēli ṣi havāṅ eṉṉum cīṉac cakkaravarttiyāl toṭakkappaṭṭatu. ic cuvariṉ perumpakuti miṅ vamica aracar kālattil (1368-1644) kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. ovvoru 300 aṭi tūrattukku oṉṟākap pala 40 aṭi uyaramuḷḷa kāvaṟ kōpuraṅkaḷuḷḷaṉa. aṭittaḷattil kaṉam 25 aṭi mutal 15 aṭi variyil māṟupaṭukiṉṟatu. uyaram 20 mutal 30 aṭi. cuvar nuṉiyiṉ akalam 15 aṭi. cuvariṉ ucciyil 10 aṭi akalamuḷḷa pātiyuṇṭu. itu ki.mu. 3ām nūṟṟāṇṭil toṭaṅkappaṭṭatu.
cērka° mākcima°: (Circus Maximus) itu urōmil ki.mu. 605il kaṭṭap paṭṭa nāṭaka araṅku. itu yūliyar cīcarāl periyatākkap paṭṭatu. itu 1875 aṭi nīḷamum 625 aṭi akalamum, 150,000 pēr irukka iṭa vacatiyu muḷḷatu. iṅku vaṇṭiccavāri, uṭaṟpayiṟci viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ naṭi peṟṟaṉa.
tācmakāl: itu kummaṭṭaṅkaḷuḷḷa caturavaṭivāṉa kallaṟi. itu calavik kallāl 1629kkum 1650kkumiṭiyil cācakāṉ eṉṉum mukamatiya aracaṉāl taṉatu maṉivi mumtaci makāliṉ camātiyāka akkirāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. itu civanta kaṟkaḷāṟ kaṭṭappaṭṭa matilkaḷuṭiya tōṭṭattiṉ naṭuvē 210 aṭi uyaramuṭiyatāka viḷaṅkukiṉṟatu. itaṉ taḷam 313 aṭi caturamuḷḷatu. kaṭṭiṭattiṉ uṭpuṟaṅkaḷ palavaki irattiṉakkaṟkaḷ patittu alaṅkarikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
tipettiya pōtalam: (Pothala of Tibet) itu tipettiṉ āṭcit tali varākiya talilāmāviṉ iruppiṭam. itu 900 aṭi nīḷamuṭiyatāy kōṭṭipōṉṟa tōṟṟamuṭiyatu. itaṟku mulām pūciya pala kūri kaḷum palvēṟu uyaramuḷḷa kōpuraṅkaḷumuṇṭu. mika uyarnta kōpuratti ṉuyaram 400 aṭi. pōtalattiṉ veḷippuṟam civappu niṟamum uṭpuṟam veṇṇiṟamu muṭiyaṉa.
nāṅkiṅ veḷḷik kaḷimaṇ kōpuram (Porcelin tower of Nanking) itu yuṅlō eṉṉum cīṉac cakkaravarttiyāl kiḻakkuc cīṉāviluḷḷa nāṉkiṅ eṉṉumiṭattil 15ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. eṭṭu mūliyiyuṭitu. itaṉ uyaram 261 aṭi. itaṟku eṭṭu allatu oṉpatu māṭikaḷiruntaṉa. itaṉ iṟappukaḷil 152 maṇikaḷum 152 kaṇṇāṭi viḷakkukaḷum toṅkaviṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. itu 1853il puraṭcikkārarāl aḻikkappaṭṭatu.
paḻaṅkālak kaṭṭukkālvāy (Ancient Aqueduct): kiṟittuva āṇṭukku muṉṉum piṉṉum paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷukku nīr utavuvataṟkup pala kaṭṭuk kāl vāykaḷ veṭṭap paṭṭiruntaṉa. ivvakik kālvāy mutalil eyupāliṉa° (Eupalenus) eṉpavaṉāl ki.mu.630il veṭṭappaṭṭatu. atu āciyā miṉarukku aṇmiyiluḷḷa cāmō° eṉṉum kirēkka tīvukku nīr koṭuttatu. urōm nakarukku oṉpatu kālvāy kaḷāl tiṉamum 40,000 kalaṉ nīr pōyk koṇṭiruntatu. paḻaṅkāla ekiptiyar, pāpilōṉiyar, erucalēmiyarkaḷum kaṭṭuk kālvāy kaḷip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ.
paḻaṅkālak kirēkkak kūttumēṭikaḷ: ki.mu. 4ām nūṟṟāṇṭil pala kūttuk kaḷarikaḷ kirīcil kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟukkuk kūri illi. avi ari vaṭṭavaṭiviṉa. aṅku kalliṉāṟ ceyyappaṭṭa ācaṉaṅ kaḷ niliyākap pōṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. (i) ṭiyōṉi ca° kaḷari 16,000 pēr irukkak kūṭiyatāka viruntatu.
pāpilōṉ toṅku tōṭṭam: (Hanging garden of Babylon) yupirāta° āṟṟukku aṇmiyil ippoḻutu īrākkukkut teṟkiluḷḷa pāk tāttukkut teṟkē nepuccaṇ nēcar eṉṉum pāpilōṉiya aracaṉ tūṇkaḷmītu kaṭṭappaṭṭa māṭikaḷil oru pūntōṭṭatti ki.mu. 600il amittāṉ. aṭukkaṭukkāka aminta kaṭṭukaḷ 75aṭi mutal 300 aṭi vari uyaramuṭiyaṉavāka viruntaṉa. mika uyarnta iṭattil māṭi yil vikkappaṭṭirunta nīrt tēkkattiliruntu kuḻāykaḷ mūlam ceṭi kaḷukku nīr viṭappaṭṭatu.
periya maṉitamukac ciṅkam: (Great sphinx) itu vaṭa ekiptil kicē eṉṉu miṭattil paṭuttirukkum pāvaṇiyil maliyil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷa maṉitamukacciṅkam. cepraṉ eṉṉum parōvā itaṉi ki.mu. 3500il veṭṭuvittāṉ. itaṉ uṭaliṉ nīḷam 189 aṭiyum, mukattiṉ kuṟuk kaḷavu 13 aṭi 8 aṅkulamum, vāyiṉ akalam 5 aṭi 7 aṅkulamumuḷḷaṉa. 50 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷa ataṉ muṉṉaṅkālkaḷiṉiṭiyē kāṟṟaṭittuk koṇṭuvanta maṇ kuvintuḷḷatu. itu ñāyiṟṟuk kaṭavuḷik kuṟikkum ciṉṉam eṉak karutappaṭukiṉṟatu.
pāra° kalaṅkari viḷakkam: (Pharos of Alexandria) itu tālami pilāṭipa° eṉṉum aracaṉāl ki.mu. 247il alakcāntiriyāt tuṟimukattukku aṇmiyiluḷḷa pāra° (Pharos) tīvil kaṭṭappaṭṭa veḷicca vīṭu. itu ki.pi. 1375il nērnta pūmi atircciyiṉāl aḻiveytiyatu.
picā cāynta kōpuram: (Leaning tower of Pisa) itu ittāliyiṉ teṉmēṟkuk kariyilirukkum picāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷa vaṭṭa vaṭivāṉa eṭṭu māṭikkōpuram. itu nēr kuttiliruntu 15 aṭi vilaki niṟkiṉṟatu. itaṉ vaṭakkup pakkattiṉ uyaram 181 aṭi; teṟkup pakkat tiṉ uyaram 179 aṭi. itu 1173il toṭaṅki 1350il muṭikkappaṭṭatu. camīpakālattil 1000 toṉ eṭiyuḷḷa cimeṇṭu itaṉ taḷattuṭ celuttappaṭṭuḷḷatu. vaṭa ittāliyil polakṉā(Bologna)vil oṉṟum, kiḻakkuc cuviṟcalāntil moṭriṭ° (St.Motritze) cil oṉṟumāka vēṟu iru carinta kōpuraṅkaḷum irukkiṉṟaṉa.
porō putūr: (Boro Budor) itu intu-yāvāvil pōrō putūr eṉṉu miṭattil erimalik kuḻampup pāṟiyil ki.pi. 8ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa putta kōyil. ikkaṭṭiṭam 150 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu. itic cuṟṟi ēḻu matilkaḷ paṭikkaṭṭuppōl kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ naṭuvē 52 aṭi viṭṭamuḷḷa tātu kōpam eḻukiṉṟatu. kōviliṉ ovvoru pakkamum 520 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷatu.puttariṉ uruvaṅkaḷ vikkappaṭṭuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷil pala tūpikaḷum oṭuṅkiya kōpuraṅkaḷum eḻukiṉṟaṉa. avi ik kōyilik kuṇṭūci kuttiya mettipōlak kāṭciyaḷikkac ceykiṉṟaṉa.
mammattuk kuki: (Mammoth Cave) itu aikkiya amerikkāvil keṉtakki eṉṉumiṭattiluḷḷatu. ik kukiyil nūṟumil tūram kaṇṭaṟiyap paṭṭuḷḷatu. ik kukiyil kōyileṉappaṭum iṭattiluḷḷa kummaṭṭam 120 aṭi uyaramum 5 ēkkar parappumuḷḷatu.
maliccikara vācikaḷiṉ araṇmaṇi: (“Place” of the cliff dwellers) kolara ṭōvil māṉkō° (Mancos) eṉṉumiṭattil paḻaṅkaṟkāla makkaḷāṟ kaṭṭappaṭṭa paḻiya kirāmamoṉṟuḷḷatu. iṅku ippoḻutu makkaḷ naṭamāṭṭamilli. iṅkuḷḷa kaṭṭaṭattil 200 periya aṟikaḷum 22 ciṟiya aṟikaḷumuḷḷaṉa. ik kaṭṭaṭatti amikkappaṭṭa kottu vēliyi nōkkumpōtu aṅku vāḻnta makkaḷ uyarnta nākarikam peṟṟiruntārkaḷeṉat terikiṟatu.
māyā makkaḷiṉ kōyilkaḷ: mattiya amerikkāvil māyāmakkaḷ eḻuppiya kōyilkaḷ ammakkaḷ uyarnta nākarikam peṟṟiruntārka ḷeṉpatik kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa. ik kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ cuṇṇāmpum maṇalum kalantu kuḻitta cāntiṉālum cuṇṇāmpuk kalliṉālum kaṭṭappaṭ ṭuḷḷaṉa. ippoḻutu aḻintu kiṭakkum kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ piramiṭṭuc camā tikaḷ pōṉṟa uyarnta mēṭikaḷiṉ mītuḷḷaṉa. kaṭṭaṅkaḷiṉ tūṇkaḷ iṟakki muḷitta pāmpukaḷ pōṉṟa tōṟṟamuṭiyavi. māyā makkaḷiṉ kaṭṭaṭak kalikkum teṉṉintiya ciṟpakkalikkum uṟavu kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.
memmoṉiṉ iraṭṭi uruvac cilikaḷ: (Twin Colossi of Memmon) ameṉ hotap parōvāviṉ iraṇṭu uruvaṅkaḷ irukkum niliyil maṇkallil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (ki.mu.14ām nū.). ivi ekiptiṉ vaṭakiḻakkiluḷḷa karnākkiluḷḷaṉa. poḻutu tōṉṟum nērattil ivi aḻuvatu pōṉṟa ōci ceykiṉṟaṉa. kuḷirnta kallil veyil veppam paṭuvatāl ivvāṟu ōci eḻukiṉṟatu eṉṟu collappaṭukiṟatu. ivvōci memmoṉ teyvattiṉ cīḻkki eṉak kirēkkar nampi vantaṉar.
micūriluḷḷa periya uruvac cili: camaṇa matam cammantappaṭṭa kōma tēcuvarar uruvaccili micūril 470 aṭi uyarnta malic cikaratti luḷḷa pāṟiyil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉ uyaram 60 aṭi; tōṭ paṭṭiyiluḷḷa akalam 26 aṭi. itu camaṇak kaṭavuḷ campantappaṭṭatu.
viṭutalic cili (Statue of Liberty): itu niyuyōkkiluḷḷa peṭlō° (Bedloes) tīvil niṟuttappaṭṭuḷḷa periya cili. itu pireñcu aracāṅ kattāl amerikkā viṭutaliyaṭinta nūṟāvatu āṇṭu viḻāviṉ pōtu amerikkāvukku aṉpaḷippākak koṭukkap paṭṭatu. itu oru peṇ vaṭivam; viṭutalic cūḷi uyarttip piṭittuk koṇṭu niṟpa tāka amintuḷḷatu. itu tuṟimukattukku mēl 310 aṭi uyara muḷḷatu. itu 3.32 aṅkulat taṭippuṭiyatākavum, uḷ veḷiyuṭiya tākavum ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉ eṭi 225 toṉ. kīḻ iruntu mēlvari paṭikkaṭṭukaḷuḷḷaṉa.
palporuḷ
akac civappuk katirkaḷ: (Infra red rays) cūriya oḷiyiṉ niṟamāliyil ali nīḷam atikamāṉa civappup pakutikku appāl kaṇṇukkup pulap paṭātuḷḷa katirkaḷ ippeyar peṟum.
akṭōpar puraṭci: 1917il uruciyāviṉ talinakarākavirunta peṭrō kirāṭṭil naṭanta pōlṣavik puraṭci ippeyar peṟum.
acceḻuttukkaḷiṉ puḷḷi: acceḻuttukkaḷiṉ aḷavu puḷḷi eṉappaṭu kiṟatu. 72 puḷḷikaḷ ōr aṅkula nīḷamākum. cātāraṇamākap puttakaṅkaḷ 11 allatu 12 puḷḷikaḷil acciṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
acaṟkuṟippu: viyāpārikaḷ kaṇakkup puttakaṅkaḷilum pēreṭṭilum patiyumuṉ pativu ceyyappaṭum ovvoru viyāpāra naṭavaṭikkiyum aṭaṅkiya puttakam eṉappaṭum.
aṭitoṭṭi: (Slughter house) cukātāra muṟiyil āṭu māṭukaḷi aṭittu māmicattip peṟuvataṟkāka amikkappaṭṭa kaṭṭaṭam. itaṟkāka aracāṅkam ēṟpaṭuttum vitikaḷuṇṭu. ulakil periya aṭi toṭṭi cikākō nakaril (amerikkā) uḷḷatu.
aṭimi nili: mikap paḻaṅkālam mutal aṭimikaḷ iruntu vantārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ perumpālum pōrkaḷil piṭikkappaṭṭa pakivarkaḷāka viruntārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ āṭu māṭukaḷip pōla viṟkavum vāṅkavum paṭṭārkaḷ. mēṟku nāṭukaḷiṟ palar āppirikkāviliruntu aṭimi kaḷip piṭittu viṟkum viyāpārattil īṭupaṭṭiruntaṉar. amerik kāvilum mēṟkintiyat tīvukaḷilum veḷḷiyariṉ paṇṇikaḷil vēliceyvōr aṭimikaḷākavē iruntārkaḷ. amerikkāvil 1865il aṭimi oḻippuc caṭṭam ceyyappaṭṭatu. appoḻutu 45 ilaṭcam aṭimikaḷ viṭutali peṟṟārkaḷ. iṅkilāntil 1792ilum piriṭṭiṣ kuṭiyēṟṟa nāṭukaḷil 1833ilum 1834il intiyāvilum aṭimi oḻikkappaṭṭatu.
aṭiyāṟu nūl niliyam: ceṉṉikkup pakkattiluḷḷa aṭiyāṟu eṉṉumiṭattil piramañāṉa caṅkattārāl niṟuvappaṭṭa nūl niliyam. itil 76,713 nūlkaḷuṇṭu.
aṭmiral: aikkiya amerikkā, iṅkilāntu eṉṉum nāṭukaḷit tavira maṟṟiya nāṭukaḷil aṭmiral eṉpatu kaṭaṟpaṭiyiṉ talimi atikāriyik kuṟikka vaḻaṅkum peyar. amerikkā, iṅkilāntu eṉ ṉum nāṭukaḷil kaṭaṟpaṭi aṭmiral eṉpatu talimip pataviyākum. kaṭaṟpaṭiyil aṭmiral eṉpatu tarippaṭiyil ceṉaral eṉpatu pōṉṟatu.
aṇikkaṭṭu: oru āṟṟiṉ pōkkit taṭuttuvittu ataṉ maṭṭat tiyum aḷaviyum kaṭṭuppaṭuttavum, nīrit tēkki vittup payaṉ paṭuttavum ataṉ kuṟukkē pōṭappaṭum taṭi.
atlāntik uṭaṉpaṭikki: itu 1949il mēṟku airōppāviluḷḷa nāṭukaḷukkum vaṭa amerikkāvukkumiṭiyē ēṟpaṭṭa ōr oppantam. itu potuvuṭimi uruciya nāṭukaḷ oṉṟupaṭṭu iyaṅkuvataṟku etiriṭiyākac caṉanāyaka nāṭukaḷ irukka vēṇṭumeṉṉum aṭip paṭiyik koṇṭatu. ivvuṭaṉpaṭikkiyil campantappaṭṭa oru nāṭṭi uruciyā tākkiṉāl maṟṟiya nāṭukaḷ utavikēṭkappaṭā malē utavikkuc cellutal vēṇṭum.
atlāntik cācaṉam: itu cēṭcilum amerikkak kuṭiyaracut talivar urū° vēlṭum 1941 āka°ṭu 14il oru pōrk kappalil atlāntik kaṭalil cantittuk kiyoppamiṭṭa oru cācaṉam. ulakil oru cātiyār iṉṉoru cātiyāri valuviṟkaṭṭiyāḷutal kūṭāteṉpatu itaṉ curukkamākum.
apē (Abey): periya kiṟittuva maṭaṅkaḷukkum kōvilkaḷōṭiṇikkap paṭṭirunta maṭaṅkaḷukkum vaḻaṅkum peyar. immaṭaṅkaḷil kiṟittuva tuṟavikaḷ vāḻntārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ apoṭ(Abbot) eṉṉum maṭat talivariṉ āḷukikkuṭpaṭṭiruntārkaḷ. kaṉṉit tuṟavikaḷ ape° (Abbess) eṉṉum taliviyiṉ āḷukikkuṭpaṭṭiruntārkaḷ.
appō°talar naṭapaṭikaḷ: kiṟittuva vētattil putiya ēṟpāṭṭiluḷḷa aintāvatu nūl; irupatteṭṭatikāraṅkaḷ koṇṭatu. iyēcuviṉ varalāṟākiya cuvicēṣaṅkaḷil oṉṟi iyaṟṟiya lūkkā eṉpavarē itiyum eḻutiṉār eṉak karutappaṭukiṟatu.
ampulaṉ°: itu kāyamaṭintavarkaḷi vittiya cālikaḷukku eṭuttuc celvatu pōṉṟa vaṇṭi. pōrk kālaṅkaḷil itu kāyampaṭṭavar kaḷukku mutalutavi aḷittu avari vittiyacālikaḷukku eṭuttuc cellap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum. itil ceñciluvi aṭiyāḷamiṭappaṭ ṭirukkum. pireñcuc cēṉiyic cērnta pāraṉ cīṉ lāri eṉpavarē ivvaṇṭiyi 1792il pōril mutaṉ muṟi payaṉpaṭuttiṉār. piṉ ellā nāṭukaḷum itaṉip payaṉpaṭuttiṉa. ampulaṉ° ōṭṭupavarum atil vēli ceypavarum naṭuniliyiṉarākak karutappaṭa vēṇṭu meṉa 1864il vakukkappaṭṭa ceṉīvā uṭaṉpaṭikki kūṟukiṉṟatu.
ammi: oru vakit toṟṟunōy. itil ciṉṉammi (Chicken Pox), periyammi (Small pox), taṭṭammi (Measles) eṉa mūṉṟu vakiyuṇṭu. periyammi mikakkoṭiyatu. itu varāmal taṭuppataṟku ammip pāl kuttappaṭukiṟatu.
ariya° matam: (Arinism) alakcāntiriyāvil vāḻnta āriya° (Arius) eṉpavar (ki.pi. 256-336) kiṟittunātar tēvaṉ allar; maṉitaril teyvattaṉmi yuṭiyavar eṉap pōtittār. ik koḷki ivar peyarāl aṟiyappaṭakiṟatu.
arttacāttiram: muriya cantirakuptaṉiṉ (ki.mu. 325 - 297) mantiriyāka virunta kuṭaliyar allatu cāṇakkiyar allatu viṭṭuṇukuptar eṉpavarāl ceyyappaṭṭa āṭci nūl.
alaṅkārak kaṭi: (Beauty Shop) mēl nāṭukaḷil peṇkaḷiṉ veḷit tōṟṟatti aḻakupaṭuttum niliyaṅkaḷ palavirukkiṉṟaṉa. aikkiya amerikkāvil māttiram ēṟakkuṟiya 60,000 kaṭikaḷirukkiṉṟaṉa. ki viral nakaṅkaḷ, tōl, pal, ki mutalivaṟṟi ivi aḻakākat tōṟṟamaḷikkac ceykiṉṟaṉa.
alrācoṉik°: (Ultasonics) maṉitaṉuṭiya kātukkuk kēṭka muṭiyāta olikaḷip paṟṟiya ārāycci. oru noṭikku 15,000 ali atirvu (Oscillations)kku mēṟpaṭṭa oli maṉitaṉuṭiya kātukkukkēḷātu. mikak kuṟinta atirvuḷḷa ōciyum kātukaḷukkuk kēṭkātu. ivi paṟṟiya ārāycci ippeyar peṟum.
āṅkilam: itu 270,000,000kku mēṟpaṭṭa makkaḷ vaḻaṅkum moḻi. im moḻiyi vaḻaṅkuvōruḷ 150,600,000kku mēṟpaṭṭōr aikkiya amerikkāviluḷar.
āriya camācam: itu tayāṉanta caracuvati eṉṉum kucarāttup pirāmaṇat tuṟaviyāl 1875il niṟuvappaṭṭa oru niliyam. itu cātimata vēṟṟumi kaḷi oppukkoḷvatilli.
ālaṅkaṭṭi: mēkattiliruntu viḻum kaṉatta paṉikkaṭṭit tuṇukku. iv vaki ālaṅkaṭṭi mirutuvāy ciṟu veṇ paṉittuṇukkukaḷip pōṉṟirukkum.
iraṭcaṇiya cēṉi: (Salvation army) itu iṅkilāntil metaṭi°ṭ pātiriyāyirunta villiyam pūt eṉpavarāl 1865il amikkappaṭṭa caṅkam. itaṟkuc cēṉi eṉṟu peyariṭappaṭṭiruppatāl itaṉ talivarkaḷic ceṉaraleṉṟum itu kūṭumiṭaṅkaḷip pāḷiyam (Barracks) eṉṟum vaḻaṅkuvar. matappaṟṟillāta makkaḷ uḷḷattik kavar vataṟkāka ic cēṉiyiṉ pōrvīrar pōl uṭuppaṇintu koṭi paṟakka viṭṭuk koṇṭu pāṇṭu vāttiyattuṭaṉ pavaṉi varuvar. iccēṉi 89 nāṭukaḷil amikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.ivarkaḷ 123 pattirikikaḷi 81 moḻikaḷil veḷiyiṭukiṟārkaḷ.
irattac cuṟṟōṭṭam: irutayam irattatti iṟikkiṟatu. irattam mutalil nūriyīralukkuc celkiṟatu. aṅku atu pirāṇavāyuviṉāl nirappap paṭukiṟatu. piṉpu atu itayattukkuc celkiṟatu. piṉpu atu irattak kuḻāy vaḻiyākac celkiṟatu. itu ciṟiya ciṟiya irattak kuḻāykaḷ vaḻi yākac ceṉṟu taci nārkaḷukkup pirāṇavāyuvik koṭuttuviṭṭuk kaḻivup poruḷi vāṅkik koṇṭu akaṉṟu akaṉṟu celkiṉṟa vēyiṉ° (Veins) eṉṉum kuḻāykaḷ vaḻiyāka itayatti aṭintu nuriyīrali aṭikiṟatu. aṅku atu kaḻivup poruḷkaḷi nīrāvi yākavum kārpaṉ ṭi ākciṭ ākavum veḷiyē viṭṭu viṭṭup putiya pirāṇavāyuvip peṟukiṟatu.
irattak kaṭṭi (Abscess): tōṟpuriyiṉ kīḻ āḻattil tīya nōyk kirumi kaḷiṉ toṟṟiṉāl uṇṭāvatu. avi peruki nañci veḷiyē viṭuvatāl avviṭattil aḻaṟciyum tiraṭciyum uṇṭākiṟatu.
irattam: mikutiyāṉa uyirkaḷukku uṭal muḻumikkum uṇavik koṇṭu ceṉṟu kaḻivup poruḷkaḷi veḷiyēṟṟum tiravap poruḷ. itil pirāṇavāyuvi uṟiñcum oru poruḷ uṇṭu. ipporuḷ irattattiluḷḷa civappu aṇukkaḷilirukkiṉṟatu. civappu aṇukkaḷ piḷā°mā eṉṉum tiravattil mitakkiṉṟaṉa. cila aṇukkaḷ veṇ ṇiṟamuṭiyaṉa. avi aṇuk kirumikaḷ nuḻintāl avaṟṟi uṇṭuviṭukiṉṟaṉa.
irāci: vāṉil cūriyaṉ celvatākat tōṉṟum vītiyākiya irāci maṇṭalam ovvoṉṟum 300 aḷavuḷḷa paṉṉiraṇṭu pākaṅkaḷākkappaṭṭu appākaṅkaḷ irācikaḷeṉappaṭum: avi mēcam, iṭapam, mituṉam, kaṭakam, ciṅkam, kaṉṉi, tulām, viruccikam, taṉucu, makaram, kumpam, mīṉam eṉpaṉa. inta irācikaḷil amiyum naṭcattiraṅkaḷ āṭu mutaliya vaṭivuṭiyaṉavākat tōṉṟutalāl ippeyarkaḷ uṇṭāyiṉa. kuḻanti piṟakkum pōtu utayattil (aṭivāṉil) uḷḷa irāci ceṉma ilakkiṉa meṉappaṭum.
irāp pōcaṉam: ciluviyil aṟiyappaṭuvataṟku mutalnāḷ iravu kiṟittu nātar cīṭarkaḷuṭaṉiruntu uṇavukoṇṭapoḻutu appattiyum tirāṭci iracattiyum toṭṭuk kaṭavuḷukku naṉṟi celuttiviṭṭu “itu eṉatu uṭal, itu eṉatu irattam, iti eṉ niṉivāka iyaṟṟuṅ kaḷ” eṉṟu kūṟiṉār. iti “yūkkari°ṭ” eṉṟum kūṟuvar. yūk kari°ṭ eṉṉum kirēkka colliṉ poruḷ naṉṟi kūṟal. iti āṅkilattil “kammūṉiyaṉ”eṉpar. atu tamiḻil naṟkaruṇi eṉappaṭum. urōmaṉ kattōlikkar itaṉi “mā°”eṉpar. purōkitar appattiyum tirāṭci iracattiyum cepaṅ kūṟik karttariṉ uṭalākavum iratta mākavum māṟṟi aṭiyārkku vaḻaṅkuvatu aitīkam. iti urōmaṉ kattōlikkar nāṭōṟum allatu vārantōṟum peṟuvārāyiṉum yēcunātar uyirtteḻunta ī°ṭar nāḷaṉṟu peṟṟāka vēṇṭum.
irumal: mūccuk kuḻāyiluḷḷa caḷiyiyō allatu aṅku cērnta piṟa poruḷkaḷiyō appuṟappaṭuttuvataṟku mēṟkoḷḷum ceyal irumal eṉappaṭukiṟatu. piṟa kāraṇaṅkaḷāl uṇṭākum irumal tīmi payappatu.
iḷampiḷḷivātam: kuḻantikaḷukku varum toṟṟu nōykaḷuḷ mikap payaṅkaramāṉatu; ki kālkaḷi muṭamākkak kūṭiyatu. innōy mikuti yum amerikkāvil kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. itu oruvaki viṭakkirumiyāl (vira°) uṇṭākiṟatu. innōy varāmal taṭuppu maruntu celuttik koḷḷalām.
iṟakukaḷ: paṟavikaḷiṉ iṟakukaḷ pallivakikaḷiṉ cetilkaḷiliruntu vaḷarcciyaṭintavi. oru iṟakil teṉṉōli pōṉṟa pala alaku kaḷum, alakukaḷil mayir pōṉṟa alakukaḷumuṇṭu. puṟāviṉ iṟaku oṉṟil ēṟakkuṟiya 1,200 periya alakukaḷum 990,000 ciṟiya alaku kaḷumuṇṭu.
iṉkā (Inca): teṉṉamerikkāvil peru, arccaṇṭiṉā, cilli mutaliya nāṭukaḷil muṟkālattil vāḻnta makkaḷ ippeyar peṟuvar. ivar kaḷiṉ aracaṉ iṉkā eṉappaṭṭāṉ. mekcikkōvil vāḻnta paḻiya makkaḷ a°ṭek° eṉappaṭṭārkaḷ.
iṉkuviciṣaṉ: kattōlikka matakkoḷkikaḷi nampātavarkaḷit, taṇṭippataṟkākap pōp 9ām kirikori 1231il koṇṭu vanta caṭṭam. iccaṭṭattiṉpaṭi camayatti nampātavarkaḷ tīyiliṭṭum, cittiravati ceytum taṇṭikkappaṭṭārkaḷ. yōṉ ov āk eṉṉum vīrappeṇ maṇi taṇṭaṉi peṟṟatu iccaṭṭattiṉ paṭiyē yākum.
ī°ṭar: kiṟittunātar uyirtteḻuntati niṉaṉavūṭṭum viḻā. itu mārc mātam 21ām nāḷilō ataṟkup piṟakō varum pūraṇikku aṭutta mutal ñāyiṟṟukkiḻami koṇṭāṭappaṭukiṟatu.
uṇṇāviratam: itu muṟkālam mutal ellāc camayattavarālum kik koḷḷappaṭṭu vantatu; iṉṟum cila camayattavarāl kikkoḷḷap paṭṭu varukiṉṟatu. paṇṭik kālattil mekcikkō, peru, pāpilōṉ, acīriyā, ekiptu, pāla°tīṉam, arēpiyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷilum, kelṭu tiyutēṉiya makkaḷiṭiyum ivvaḻakkam kāṇappaṭṭatu. intu, putta, camaṇa, mukamatiya, kiṟittuva, yūtamatattiṉariṭiyum itu iṉṟum iruntu varukiṟatu.
uram (pacaḷi): nilattiliruntu tāvaraṅkaḷ uṟiñci eṭuttukkoṇṭa iracāyaṉap poruḷkaḷi īṭu ceyvataṟkāka nilattukku uramiṭap paṭukiṟatu. urattil niṭraciṉum pācuvaramum aṭaṅkiyirukkum.
etir aṭiyiṭam: (Antipodes) nām niṟpataṟkuk kīḻē pūmiyiṉ maṟupuṟatti luḷḷa iṭam.
eppiril: āṇṭil nāṉkāvatu mātam. ippeyar virital eṉṉum peyar paṭum. ilāttiṉ colliṉiṉṟum piṟantatu. ikkālam mutal pūkkaḷum taḷirkaḷum virivil virikiṉṟaṉa.
eri naṭcattirakkal: eri naṭcattiram periyatāṉāl muḻuvatum erivataṉ muṉ atu pūmiyi aṭiyalām. avvāṟu viḻum kaṟkaḷ eri naṭcat tirakkaṟkaḷ eṉappaṭum. avi pūmiyi aṇuka aṇukak kāṟṟiṉ taṭi mikuvatāl viḻum vēkam taṭippaṭum; muṉpōl erivatilli. avi tuṇṭukaḷāka uṭintuviṭukiṉṟaṉa. cila camayaṅkaḷil periya naṭcattirak kaṟkaḷ viḻuvatumuṇṭu. 1908il periya naṭcattirakkal cipīriyāvil viḻuntapōtu 25 mil cuṟṟiluḷḷa kāṭukaḷ aḻintu viṭṭaṉa. ēṟakkuṟiya 4000 āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉ aricōṉāvil oru periya vāṉak kal viḻuntatāl uṇṭāṉa paḷḷam 570 aṭi āḻamum 4/5 mil viṭṭamumuḷḷatu.
eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷ: (Metoer) vāl naṭcattiraṅkaḷ kavarcciyiṉ kāraṇamāka ētāvatu oru periya kirakattiyō cūriyaṉiyō aṇukalām. aṅkuḷḷa ellikkumēl aṇukiṉāl avi uṭikiṉṟaṉa. at tuṇṭukaḷē eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷākiṉṟaṉa. vēṟu aṇṭaṅkaḷ uṭin tum eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uṇṭākalām. ivi puviyīrppiṉāl vāyu maṇṭalattil nuḻiyumāṉāl cekkaṇṭukku 40 milukku atikap paṭṭa vēkattil varum. appoḻutu kāṟṟilē uṇṭākum urāyvi ṉāl 40000 veppamaṭintu erikiṉṟaṉa. veḷiccam pulappaṭuvatu 80 mil uyarattilākum.perumpālum pūmiyi aṭiyumuṉ avi erintuviṭukiṉṟaṉa. nāḷtōṟum ilaṭcak kaṇakkāṉa eri naṭcat tiraṅkaḷ pūmiyil viḻukiṉṟaṉa.
erimali: pūmikkuḷḷirukkum urukiya kaṟkuḻampu veḷiyē taḷḷap paṭuvatāl kuvintu kūmpu vaṭivākavirukkum malikaḷ erimalikaḷ eṉappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. erimalikaḷ uṟaṅkum erimalikaḷ viḻi eri malikaḷ eṉa iruvakippaṭum.
elumpu: mutukelumpuḷḷa uyirkaḷiṉ taṭimayamāṉa kūṭṭi elumpu eṉki ṟōm. itu kālciyam po°pēṟ eṉṉum iracāyaṉap poruḷāl periyatum uṇṭākkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. elumpiluḷḷa cila celkaḷ paṭi paṭiyākap paṭintu elumpi uṇṭākkukiṉṟaṉa.
aintām paṭi: oru nāṭṭiluḷḷavarkaḷē an nāṭṭiṟku etirāka vēli ceyyum pakivarkaḷukku utava muṉvariṉ avarkaḷ aintām paṭi yiṉar eṉappaṭuvar. i°pēyiṉil uḷnāṭṭuk kuḻappattiṉ pōtu pirāṅkō 4 aṇiyāka niṉṟu māṭriṭ nakarit tākkiṉār. pirāṅkō viṉ aṉutāpikaḷ aracāṅkattuḷ iruntapaṭiyē kuḻappaṅkaḷi uṇṭākkiṉārkaḷ. ivvāṟu ceytavarkaḷ aintām paṭiyiṉareṉap paṭṭārkaḷ.
aimperuṅkāppiyaṅkaḷ: cilappatikāram, maṇimēkali, cīvakacintāmaṇi, vaḷiyāpati, kuṇṭalakēci eṉpaṉa. piṉṉiraṇṭu nūlkaḷum maṟintupōyiṉa.
oruppaṭi: (Uniform) pōr vīrar, cāraṇar, poli° pōṉṟa kūṭṭattiṉar aṇiyum orēvaki uṭuppu. piriṭṭicār 1880il intiya turuppu kaḷukkuk kākki uṭuppiṉi vakuttaṉar. kākki eṉṉum intu°tāṉic col puḻuti niṟam eṉṟu poruḷpaṭum. pōyar pōrukkup piṉ kākki uṭuppu aṇivatu ulaka muḻumiyum paraviyatu. ippoḻutu araciyaṟ karuttuc campantamāṉa koḷkikaḷi viḷakkac cila kūṭṭattiṉar civappu, kaṟuppu mutaliya uṭikaḷiyu maṇikiṉṟaṉar.
olimpik āṭṭaṅkaḷ: nāṉku āṇṭukaḷukku orumuṟi naṭipeṟum ulaka āṭṭappōṭṭikaḷ. ivi paṇṭik kālak kirēkkariṉ tēcīya viḻāviṉ maṟumalarcciyākum. ivviḻāvi avarkaḷ olimpiyā eṉṉum camaveḷiyil ciya° eṉṉum teyvattiṉ vaḻipāṭāka naṭatti vantamiyāl olimpik āṭṭaṅkaḷ eṉṉum peyaruṇṭāyiṟṟu.
oṭṭam tuḷḷal: kēraḷa nāṭṭil vaḻaṅkum pukaḻpeṟṟa nāṭṭuk kūttu. itu orāḷ naṭaṉam. naṭaṉamāṭupavar īraṭippāṭal oṉṟip pāṭi ataṉ karutti apinayaṅkaḷāl kuṟippiṭuvar. avarukkup piṉpuṟam niṟkum mattaḷakkārar appāṭali maṟupaṭiyum pāṭi mattaḷamaṭippar. avar pāṭi muṭintatum naṭaṉakkārar aṭutta īraṭip pāṭalip pāṭuvar.
orkaṇṭi: (Organdy) ilēcum, kampipōṉṟa viṟippum oḷi pukaviṭum tiṟaṉumuḷḷa oruvakit tuṇi. orkaṇṭi eṉṉumiṭattil ceyyappaṭu talāl itaṟku ippeyar vaḻaṅkukiṉṟatu.
oḷavi illam: ceṉṉiyil aṭiyāṟṟiluḷḷa ōr illam. iṅku ātaravaṟṟa ciṟuvar ciṟumikaḷit tīya paḻakkaṅkaḷil viṭāmal pēṇik kāppāṟṟappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉar.
kaṭalnīriṉ aḻuttam: kaṭaluḷ 15,000 aṭi āḻattil oru catura aṅkula iṭattil tākkum aḻuttam 2½ toṉ. ivvaḷavaḻuttamuḷḷa iṭatti lum ataṉ kīḻum mīṉ vakikaḷ vāḻkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟi mēlē koṇṭu vantāl aḻuttam kuṟivatāl avi veṭittuviṭum. āḻkaṭal mīṉ kaḷukku veḷiccatti uṇṭākkum uṟuppukkaḷ uṭampiluṇṭu.
kampaḷi: palavaki vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mayir kampaḷi eṉappaṭukiṟatu. kampaḷi vakikaḷil mukkiyamuṭiyatu cemmaṟiyāṭṭiṉ mayir. cila veḷḷāṭ ṭiṉ mayiriyum kampaḷi eṉpatuṇṭu. tipettu nāṭṭu veḷḷāṭṭiṉ mayir kāṣmīr eṉavum, aṅkōrā veḷḷāṭṭiṉ mayir mōkēr eṉa vum pēru nāṭṭiluḷḷa alpakkā eṉṉum vilaṅkiṉ mayir alpakkā eṉavum vaḻaṅkum. oṭṭakattiṉ mayirum melliya uṭikaḷukkup payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
kuṭal: oṉṟari aṭiyuḷḷa maṉitavayiṟṟil 25 aṭi ciṟu kuṭalum, 5 aṭi peruṅkuṭalum aṭaṅkik kiṭakkiṉṟaṉa.
kuṟumpaṉṟi: itu kuṟumāṉ, cuṇṭumāṉ eṉavum aṟiyappaṭum. kuḷampuḷḷa pirāṇikaḷil mikac ciṟiyatu. 10-12 aṅkulamuyara mirukkum. itu intiyā, ilaṅki, āppirikkā, malāyā mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭum.
kēpiḷ: (Cable) miṉ kaṭattum kampikaḷ palavaṟṟi oṉṟu cērttuk kāppiṭṭavaṭam. kāppukku mēlum ōr uṟi irukkum. ivvuṟiyik kārīyattiṉāl ceyvatu vaḻakkam. itu kaṭalnīr, maṇ mutaliyavaṟṟāl kēpiḷ arikkappaṭṭu viṭāmal pātukākkiṟatu.
kēmpirik: (Cambric) cātāraṇa parutti nuhliṉāl ceyyappaṭum oruvakit tuṇi. pirāṉciluḷḷa kēmpirē (Cambri) eṉṉumiṭattil ivvakit tuṇi ceyyappaṭṭamiyāl itaṟku ippeyar vaḻaṅkukiṟatu.
kilāyam: tipettiluḷḷa mali; imayamalit toṭaric cērntatu; uyaram 22,028 aṭi; cuṟṟaḷavu iraṇṭu mil. itaṉi intukkaḷum puttarum tuhymiyiṟ ciṟanta iṭamākak koḷvar.
kokkippuḻu: cātāraṇamāka oru kokkippuḻu maṉita uṭaliṟ pukunta aintu vāraṅkaḷil muṭṭiyiṭat toṭaṅkum. oru nāḷikku oru puḻu 25,000 - 35,000 muṭṭikaḷiṭum. ippaṭi nāḷtōṟum iṭṭukkoṇṭirukkum. pala puḻukkaḷ 5,6 mātam uyirōṭirukkum maṟṟum pala 5, 6 āṇṭukaḷ uyirōṭirukkum. 16 āṇṭukaḷ uyirō ṭirunta puḻukkaḷumuṇṭu.
koḻumputtiṭṭam: kommaṉveltu ālōcaṉik kuḻuviṉar 1950il ciṭṉi, koḻumpu, ilaṇṭaṉ ākiya iṭaṅkaḷil kūṭit teṟku, teṉ mēṟku āciyāviṉ poruḷātāra muṉṉēṟṟattukku vakutta tiṭṭam. ilaṅki, intiyā, malāyā. piriṭṭiṣ, pōrṇiyō, pāki°tāṉ. ā°tirēliyā, kaṉaṭā, kampōṭiyā, intōṉēciyā, niyucīlantu, iṅkilāntu, parmā, ilāvō° (Laos) nēpāḷam, amerikkā, viyaṭnām ākiya nāṭukaḷ ittiṭṭattil cērntuḷḷaṉa.
cama aḻuttakkōṭu: (Isobar) tēcappaṭattil kāṟṟiṉ aḻuttam camamāka uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷic cērkkum kōṭu. ikkōṭukaḷ oru kuṟippiṭṭa veḷiyil allatu ulakam muḻuvatilum oru kuṟippiṭṭa kālattil nilaviya aḻuttattiṉ carācariyik kāṭṭa variyappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
cama iravukaḷ: (Equinoxes) pūmattiya rēkiyil vāḻpavarkaḷukku ellā nāṭkaḷilum iravu nēramum pakal nēramum camamāka irukkum. itē pōl cūriyaṉ pūmattiya rēkiyit tāṇṭum nāṭkaḷil mārccu 23, cepṭampar 23 tētikaḷil pūmiyiṉ ellā iṭaṅkaḷilum iravu pakal camamākavirukkum. inta nāṭkaḷ cama iravukaḷ eṉappaṭum.
camakkāḷam: parutti nūliṉāl ceyyappaṭum virippuc camakkāḷa meṉavum urōmattiṉāl neyyappaṭuvatu kampaḷameṉavum paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
calpā maruntukaḷ: (Sulpa drugs) uṭaliṟ pukuntu nōyi viḷikkum nuṇ kirumikaḷiṉ vaḷarcciyit taṭiceytu nōyi oḻikkum taṉmiyip peṟṟuḷḷa cila iracāyaṉa maruntup poruḷkaḷukku ip peyar vaḻaṅkum. nilakkariyiliruntu peṟappaṭum cila poruḷkaḷiliruntu ivi tayārikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
cavukku maram: itil 35 vakikaḷuṇṭu. ivaṟṟil perumpālāṉavi ā°tirēliyāviṟ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. maṟṟavi malāyā, niyū kaliṭōṉiyāviṟ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. cavukku maram intiyāvukku 19ām nuhṟṟāṇṭil ā°tirēliyāviliruntu koṇṭu varappaṭṭatu. cavukkiṉ ilikaḷ kācōvāri eṉṉum kōḻiyiṉ iṟakukaḷip pōṉṟu tōṉṟuvatāl ataṟkuk kācuvāriṉēci eṉa viññāṉap peyar iṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
cākkalēṭṭu: (Chocolate) itu kokkō vitiyiliruntu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. toṭakkattil mekcikkō nāṭṭiṉar kokkō vitiyiliruntu oru vita pāṉattic ceytu kuṭittuvantaṉar. avarkaḷiṭamiruntu i°pēyiṉ nāṭṭavar kokkōp pāṉam ceyyak kaṟṟaṉar. piṉ cākkalēṭṭut tayārittaṉar. ēṟakkuṟiya nūṟāṇṭukaḷāka i°pāṉiyar iti irakaciyamāka vittiruntaṉar. piṉ ittāli, pirāṉ°, cermaṉi mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkuc cākkalēṭṭuc ceyyum muṟi paraviyatu. 1657il ilaṇṭaṉil cākkalēṭṭu oru pireñcukkārāl mutaṉmutal viṟkappaṭṭatu. 1700il pāl kalantu cākkalēṭṭuc ceyyum muṟiyi āṅkilēyar kaṇṭupiṭittaṉar. ulakil cākkalēṭṭi mikutiyāka uṭkoḷḷum nāṭu amerikkā. kuṟinta aḷavil mikunta cakti tarum uṇavu cākkalēṭṭu. ulakil cākkalēṭṭi mikutiyākac ceyyum nāṭukaḷ teṉṉamerikkā, mēṟkintiyat tīvukaḷ, āppirikkāviluḷḷa kōlṭukō°ṭṭu (kāṉā).
cākittiya kaḻakam: intiya aracāṅkattiṉāl 12.4.1954il niṟuvappaṭṭa tēciya ilakkiya vaḷarccik kaḻakam.
cācaṉaviyal: (Epigraphy) paḻaṅkāla eḻuttukkaḷi aṟiyavum avaṟṟiṉ poruḷkaḷi viḷakkavum ēṟpaṭṭa kali.
cāmpaṟ putaṉ: (Ash Wednesday) itu ileṉeṉṭ nāḷiṉ ārampatiṉam. pāva maṉṉippuk kēṭpavarkaḷ mītu cāmpalit teḷippatiliruntu ippeyar vantatu.
cāranāt: vaṭa intiyāvil kācikku vaṭakkē nāṉku mil toliviluḷḷa iṭam. puttar ñāṉōpatēcam peṟṟa piṉṉar ki.mu. 588il cāranāttil māṉkāṭṭil tam paḻiya tōḻarkaḷukkut tām peṟṟa ñāṉattip pōtittār. iṅku acōkar pala tūpikaḷiyum oru cācaṉat tūṇiyum niṟuviṉār.
cirōkkō: (Serocco) teṉ mattiya tarip pakutikaḷil vīcum veppamāṉa teṉkāṟṟu.
cāppaḷḷattākku: (Death Valley) itu vaṭaamerikkāvilē kalipōrṇiyā vil mikac cūṭāṉatum paḷḷamāṉatumākiya iṭam. itu kaṭal maṭṭatti liruntu 276 aṭi kīḻē irukkiṉṟatu. itu ēṟakkuṟiya 50 mil nīḷamuḷḷatu. itaṉik kaṭakkacceṉṟa 49 pēr māṇṭu pōyiṉamiyiṉ itaṟku ippeyar vaḻaṅkukiṉṟatu.
cipirālṭar kuṉṟu: (The rock of Gibraltar) itu mattiya tarik kaṭalukkuc cellum vāyilil i°peyiṉukkum āppirikkāvukkum iṭiyi luḷḷa mattiya tarik kaṭaluḷ taḷḷi vaḷintirukkum oru kuṉṟu. itaṉ uyaram 1396 aṭi. itu taṉimiyākavum kampīramākavum irukkum tōṟṟam kuṟippiṭattakkatu.
civantavāvikaḷ: putiya mekcikkōvil (New Mexico) periya veḷḷi maṇalkaḷ (Great White Sands) eṉṉum vaṉāntara maṇal kantakac cuṇṇāmpuk (Gypsum) kalliṉālāṉatu. maḻi kālattil iṅku iratta niṟamuḷḷa nīr kuḷaṅkaḷāka niṟintu niṟpatuṇṭu.
tikkitterip paḷḷam: (The valley of Tikitere) itu niyucīlantiluḷḷatu. iṅku koti cēṟṟukkuḷaṅkaḷum, vennīrūṟṟukkaḷum kantakappukiyum iruppatālum ivaṟṟiṉ koṭiya taṉmikaḷālum itu ‘narakam’ eṉap paṭukiṉṟatu.
nōy: nuṇ kirumikaḷ, vira° puḻukkaḷ mutaliyaṉa nōykaḷi uṇ ṭākkalām. ūṭṭak kuṟiviṉālum nōykaḷ uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa. vayatu ceṉṟavarkaḷukku palak kuṟivu kāraṇamāka nōyuṇṭākalām.
pañcāṅkam: (Almanac) nāḷ, vāram, mātam, āṇṭu mutaliyavaṟṟōṭu amāvāci, pūraṇi, cantiraṉiṉ celavu viḻākkaḷ pōṉṟavaṟṟik kāṭṭum nuhl.
palaṭ āṭṭam: (Ballet) katiyik kūttiṉālum uṭal aṅkaṅkaḷiṉ aciviṉālum āṭik kāṭṭum mēl nāṭṭu naṭaṉam. itu 15ām nūṟ ṟāṇṭil toṭaṅkip pirāṉ°, iṅkilāntu, uruciyā, aikkiya amerikkā mutaliya nāṭukaḷil peritum vaḷarcciyaṭintatu.
pātippiṉmi: (Immunity) ammi, neruppuk kāyccal, piḷēk, pōṉṟa nōykaḷ pātiyātapaṭi maruntukaḷ ūcimulam pukuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉāl uṭalil an nōykaḷi etirkkum cakti uṇṭākiṟatu. oru muṟi innōy kaṇṭavarkaḷukku annōykaḷiṉ pātippiṉmi uṇṭākiṟatu.
periya uppu veḷikaḷ: (Great salt Plins) aikkiya amerikkāvil oklakōmā (Oklahoma) eṉṉumiṭattiluḷḷa uppu veḷi eṭṭu mil nīḷamum āṟu mil akalamumuḷḷatu. iṅku oḷiyiṉāl kaṇṇik kūcac ceyyum veṇṇiṟa uppuḷatu.
pipiḷ: kiṟittavarkaḷiṉ vētam. itil paḻiya ēṟpāṭu, putiya ēṟpāṭu eṉa iraṇṭu pakutikaḷuṇṭu. paḻiya ēṟpāṭu epirēyamoḻiyilum putiya ēṟpāṭu kirēkka moḻiyilum eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa. paḻiya ēṟpāṭu ki.mu. 300 mutal ki.pi. 300 vari kirēkka moḻiyil moḻi peyarkkappaṭṭatu. ki.pi. 2ām nuhṟṟāṇṭil pipiḷ muḻumiyum ilāttiṉil moḻi peyarkkappaṭṭatu. 14ām nuhṟṟāṇṭiṉiṟutiyil vikkiḷiv eṉpavar pipiḷ muḻuvatiyum āṅkilattil moḻi peyarttār. itu ēṟakkuṟiya 200 moḻikaḷil moḻi peyarkkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.
malikkiḻavam: (Old man of the mountin) itu niyuhām ciyaril (aikkiya amerikkā) veḷḷi maliyiṉ ceṅkuttāṉa pāṟiyil oru maṉita mukattiṉ pakkattōṟṟam kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. neṟṟiyil vilvaṭivāṉa puruvam 100 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu.
maṟiyum nīruṟṟu: (Sinking Creek) itu kentakki (aikkiya amerikkā) yiluḷḷa nīruṟṟu. itu caṭutiyil nilattiṉkīḻ maṟintu mikap pala milkaḷ ceṉṟu malikkuki oṉṟiṉ aṭiyāl veḷivarukiṉṟatu. itu nāṭakattil tiriyiṉ kāṭci pōṉṟatu.
malēriyāc curam: itu aṉōpili° eṉṉum nuḷampuk kaṭiyiṉāluṇṭā kiṟatu. nuḷampu kaṭittu irattatti uṟiñcumpōtu nōyk kirumikaḷi uṭampil pukuttiviṭukiṉṟatu. ik kirumikaḷ irattattiṟkiṭantu perukutalāl malēriyāc curamuṇṭākiṟatu.
mūḷi: narampu mayamāṉa ticukkaḷiṉ tiraṭci. itu uṭampiṉ toḻiṟ pāṭṭik kaṭṭuppaṭuttukiṟatu. itu pulaṉ uṟuppukkaḷ ceytikaḷi aṟintu eṉṉa ceyyavēṇṭumeṉpati tacinārkaḷukku (Muscles) aṟivikkiṉṟatu.
mellum piciṉ: (Chewing gum) cappōṭṭā eṉṉum cīmi iluppi marappāliruntu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. cappōṭṭā veppa maṇṭala amerikka maram.

vāṉiyal
(tūram ēṟakkuṟiya)
pūmiyiṉ āram (Radius) 4000 mil
” cuṟṟaḷavu 25,000 ”
cantiraṉiṉ tūram pūmiyiliruntu 258,000 ”
pūmiyiṉ tūram cūriyaṉiliruntu 93,000,000 ”
mikakkiṭṭiya naṭcattirattiṉ tūram 4.3 veḷicca āṇṭu.
oru veḷicca āṇṭiṉ tūram 5,880,000,000,000, mil
cāntiraṉiṉ kuṟukkaḷavu 2,613 ”
cūriyaṉiṉ kuṟukkaḷavu 846,000 ”
cūriyaveḷiccam pūmikkuvara ākum nēram 8 nimiṭam
pūmi cūriyaṉic cuṟṟivara ākum kālam 365 1/4 nāṭkaḷ
cūriyaṉic cuṟṟivarum kirakaṅkaḷ: putaṉ, veḷḷi, pūmi, cevvāy, viyāḻaṉ, caṉi, yūrāṉa°, neptiyūṉ, puḷuttō
cevvāykkum viyāḻaṉukkumiṭiyil ciṟukiraṅkaḷ vaḷiyam pōl cūḻntirukkiṉṟaṉa.
kirakaṅkaḷiyum cūriyaṉiyum cūḻntu kaṭikārattippōla naṭcattira maṇṭalamirukkiṉṟatu. ataṉ naṭcattiraṅkaḷ neruṅkik kāṇappaṭum pakuti pālvīti maṇṭalameṉap paṭukiṟatu.
namakkup pulappaṭum naṭcattira maṇṭalattippōla pala āyiram naṭcattira maṇṭalaṅkaḷuṇṭu
cantiraṉ pūmikkum cūriyaṉukkumiṭiyil vantu cūriya oḷiyi maṟikkum pōtu cūriyakirakaṇamuṇṭākiṟatu.
pūmi cūriyaṉukkum cantiṉukkumiṭiyil vantu taṉatu niḻalic cantiraṉ mītu viḻuttum pōtu cantikirakaṇamuṇṭākiṟatu
cantiraṉiṉ orupakkam māttiram eppoḻutum eṅkaḷukkut terikiṟatu
cantiraṉ pūmiyic cuṟṟivara 29½ nāṭkaḷākiṟatu.
cantiraṉmītu paṭum cūriyoḷi cantiraṉiṉ orupakutiyi veḷiccamaṭiyac ceykiṟatu.
pūmi, cevvāy, viyāḻaṉ, caṉi, yūrāṉ°, neptiyūṉ mutaliya kirakaṅ kaḷukku muṟiyē 1,2,12,10,4,1 cantirarkaḷuṇṭu
putaṉ, veḷḷi, pūmi, cevvāy, viyāḻaṉ, caṉi, yūrāṉa°, neptiyūṉ, puḷuṭṭō mutaliya kirakaṅkaḷ tammittāmē cuṟṟivara ākum kālam: muṟiyē 88 nāḷ; 30 nāḷ; 1 nāḷ, 24 maṇi, 27 ni.; 9 maṇi, 50 ni.;

āṅkilap paḻamoḻikaḷ

1. Where the bee sucks honey, the spider sucks poison
ī tēṉuṟiñcumiṭattil cilanti nañci uṟiñcukiṟatu.
2. When war begins hell opens
yuttam toṭaṅkumpōtu narakam tiṟakkappaṭukiṟatu
3. When children stand quiet they have done some ill 
ciṟuvar pēcātu niṉṟāl avarkaḷ ētum kuṟumpu ceytiruppārkaḷ
4. Wake not a sleeping lion
uṟaṅkukiṟa ciṅkatti eḻuppātē
5. Two ears to one tongue, therefore hear twice as much as you speak
iraṇṭu kātukaḷukku oru nāvirukkiṟatu; ākavē pēcuvatilum iru maṭaṅku atikam kēṭka vēṇṭum.
6. To run with the hare and hunt with hounds
muyalōṭum ōṭi nāyōṭum vēṭṭiyāṭuvatu
7. Thrift is phliosophers stone
cikkaṉameṉpatu iracavātak kuḷiki
8. The worst wheel of a cart creeks most
mikamōcamāṉa vaṇṭiccakkaram atikam kiṟīcciṭukiṟatu
9. The higher up, the greater fall
uyaram evvaḷavu peritu, avvaḷavukku viḻukiyum peritāka virukkum
10. The eye that sees all things else sees not itself
ellāvaṟṟiyum kāṇum kaṇ taṉṉik kāṇamāṭṭātu.
11. The crow thinks her own bird fairest
taṉṉiṉappaṟavi aḻakiyateṉak kākam niṉikkiṟatu.
12. Burnt child dreads the fire
cūṭupaṭṭa kuḻanti neruppik kaṇṭu payappaṭum
13. The bough that bear most hang lowest
atikam kāytta maram atikam vaṇaṅki niṟkum
14. Strike while iron is hot
cūṭāyirukkumpōtu irumpi aṭi
15. Step by step the ladder ascends
paṭippaṭiyāka ēṇi uyarukiṟatu
16. Silence is the best ornament of a woman
amiti peṇṇukkuc ciṟanta āparaṇam
17. Prise to the face is open disgrace
mukattukku nērē pukaḻtal pakiraṅka avamāṉam
18. Pleasure has a sting in its til
cukāṉupavaṅkaḷiṉ vālil koṭukkuṇṭu
19. Never two late to learn
paṭippataṟku eppavum kālam pōkavilli
20. Lawers houses are bulit on the heads of fools
niyāyavātikaḷiṉ vīṭukaḷ mūṭariṉ taliyil kaṭṭappaṭṭiruk kiṉṟaṉa.
21. Truth has a good face, but bad clothes
uṇmikku aḻakiya mukamuṇṭu, aḻakiya uṭi illi.
22. A dog will not howl if you beat him with a bone
elumpāl aṭittāl nāy ūḷiyiṭātu
23. A fox is not taken twice in the same snare
orumuṟi paṭṭa valiyil iraṇṭāvatu muṟi atē nari paṭamāṭṭātu
24. A good wife and health is a man’s best wealth
oru nalla maṉiviyum tēkacukamum maṉitaṉuṭiya ciṟanta celvam.
25. A great dowry is a bed full of brambles
atika cītaṉam paṭukkiyil niṟinta muḷ
26. A small leak will sink a ship 
ciṟiya tuvāram periya kappali āḻttum
27. Bees that have honey in their mouths have stings in their tils
vāyil tēṉ vittirukkum tēṉīkkaḷukku vālil kuttum koṭukkuṇṭu
28. Better an egg today than a hen tomorrow
nāḷi kiṭikkum pēṭṭuk kōḻiyilum pārkka iṉṟu kiṭikkum muṭṭimēl.
29. Beware of silent dog and still water
amitiyāka niṟkum nāykkum amitiyāṉa nīrukkum eccarikkiyāka iru.
30. Bitter pills may have wholesome effect
kippāṉa kuḷikikaḷil nalla kuṇamirukkalām.
31. Diet cures more than doctors
maruttuvarilum pārkka uṇavu nōyit tīrkkiṟatu.
32. Great talkers are great liars
atikam pēcuvōr periya poyyar.
33. Great winds blows upon high hills
peruṅkāṟṟu uyarnta malikaḷil vīcukiṟatu.
34. Idle brins are the devils workshops
cōmpēṟi mūḷikaḷ pēyiṉ toḻiṟcālikaḷ.
35. Hares may pull dead lions by the beard
cetta ciṅkaṅkaḷiṉ tāṭiyi muyalkaḷāl piṭittiḻukka muṭiyum.
36. A fool may ask more questions in an hour than a wise man can answer in seven years.
putticāli ēḻu āṇṭukaḷil viṭikāṇa muṭiyāta kēḷvikaḷi oru mūṭaṉ oru maṇi nērattil kēṭkalām.


viṭṭamiṉkaḷ
viṭṭamiṉkaḷ: uṭampu toḻiṟpaṭuvataṟku vēṇṭiyaṉavum cila uṇavu vakikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭuvaṉavumākiya oruvakic cattukkaḷ. ivi ceyaṟki muṟikaḷil kuḷikikaḷākavum, tiravavakikaḷākavum ceyyappaṭṭu pōtiya viṭṭamiṉ cattillāta uṇavu koḷpavar kaḷukkuk koṭukkap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
ē(A) viṭṭamiṉ: itu uṭal vaḷarccikkum ticukkaḷiṉ vaḷarccikkum vēṇṭiyatu. itu mālikkaṇ nōyit taṭukkiṟatu. itu pāl, muṭṭi, veṇṇey, mīṉeṇṇey, ilipōl pacciyum mañcaḷniṟamu muḷḷa tāvaravakikaḷ, mañcaḷ niṟap paḻaṅkaḷ, vāḻippaḻam, tōṭam paḻam, (ārēñcu) mutaliyavaṟṟiluṇṭu.
viṭṭamiṉ pi1(B1): itu narampukaḷ toḻilpaṭuvataṟku vēṇṭiyatu. itu illāviṭil peri peri eṉṉum nōy uṇṭākiṟatu. itu tāṉi yaṅkaḷ, muṭṭiyiṉ mañcaṭkaru, āṭṭiṟicci, māṭṭiṟicci, koṭ mīṉ, cāṭiṉ mīṉ mutaliyavaṟṟiluṇṭu.
viṭṭamiṉ pi2(B2): itu G viṭṭamiṉ eṉavum paṭum. itu vaḷarccikkum tōl nōyiṉṟiruppataṟkum vēṇṭiyatu. itu veṇṇeyallāta maṟṟiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷiluṇṭu.
viṭṭamiṉ ci: itu elumpiyum palliyum palamākavirukkac cey kiṉṟatu. kāyaṅkaḷi āṟac ceykiṟatu; irattakkuḻāykaḷiṉ cuvar kaḷip palamaṭiyac ceykiṟatu. itu elumiccampaḻam, ārēñcuppaḻam, takkāḷi, pacci niṟamuḷḷa kīrivakikaḷiluṇṭu. itu illāviṭil °kēvi eṉṉum coṟi karappāṉ nōy uṇṭākiṟatu.
viṭṭamiṉ ṭi: itu kaṇinōyi (rickets) taṭukkiṟatu. itu veyili liruntu atikam kiṭikkiṟatu. eṇṇeykaḷ, pāl, muṭṭiyiṉ mañcaṭkaru eṉpavaṟṟil itu uṇṭu.
viṭṭamiṉ ī: itikkuṟittu atikam aṟiyappaṭavilli. itu iṉap perukkattoḻiṟ pāṭṭukku vēṇṭiyatu. itu kōtumi muḷi, muṭṭi, tāvara eṇṇey ivikaḷiluṇṭu.
viṭṭamiṉ kē: irattam uṟivataṟku itu tēviyāṉatu. itu kīrivaki kaḷilum, pāl, pāluṇavukaḷilumuṇṭu.

payiṟci viṉākkaḷ
I
1. nōrvēyil kāṇappaṭum pirāṇikaḷil etu kūṭṭamākac ceṉṟu taṟkoli purintu koḷkiṉṟatu ?
2. vaṉāntaraṅkaḷil evvakit tāvaraṅkaḷ vaḷarkiṉṟaṉa ?
3. kacakacāc ceṭiyiliruntu eṉṉa maruntu eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu ?
4. pīrukkuc cuviyūṭṭa eṉṉa vēṇṭum ?
5. tēṉīkkaḷil kuttum koṭukkillātatetu ?
6. mika nīṇṭa pavaḷap pāṟit tiṭṭukaḷ eṅku kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa ?
7. kirēkkariṉ kalvit teyvam etu ? atteyvattiṉ paṟavi etu?
8. tirōcaṉ (Trojan) pōr ettaṉi āṇṭukaḷ naṭantatu ?
9. kirēkka teyvaṅkaḷ emmaliyil uṟintaṉa ?
10. viññāṉattil paḻamiyuṭiyatu etu eṉak karutappaṭukiṟatu?
11. pirāṇavāyuvik kaṇṭupiṭittavar yār ?
12. viliyuyarnta (Precious) ulōkaṅkaḷ evi ?
13. mikap pāramāṉa taṉimam etu ?
14. cātāraṇa veppa niliyil nīrmayamāka irukkum ulōka metu ?
15. cōk, calavic cōṭā, epcam cālṭ eṉpavaṟṟiṉ viññāṉap peyarkaḷeṉṉa ?
16. cōṭiyam kuḷōriṭ(Sodium chloride)-cukiṟō° (Sucrose) cōṭiyam-pi-kārpaṉēṭ, (Sodium-bi-Carbonate) eṉṉum viññāṉap peyarkaḷ cātāraṇamāka eppaṭi aṟiyappaṭum ?
17. ilitma° (Litmus) tāḷil amilam paṭṭāl eṉṉa vākum ?
18. viṉākiriyil eṉṉa amilam irukkiṟatu ?
19. elumiccampaḻam ēṉ puḷikkiṟatu ?
20. veṭi maruntil eṉṉa poruḷkaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa ?
21. kūḻmuṭṭi ēṉ keṭṭamaṇam vīcukiṟatu ?
22. taṇṇīr taṭippāṉatu eṉṟu eppoḻutu collukiṟōm?
23. mōṭṭār vaṇṭiyil kuḻāy mulam veḷivarum pukiyil (Exhust fumes) eṉṉa naccu vāyu irukkiṟatu ?
24. irumpu ēṉ turuppiṭikkiṟatu ?
25. veḷḷi nāṇayaṅkaḷ ippoḻutu eppaṭic ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa ?
26. taṇṇīriliruntu eṉṉa ulōkam eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu ?

1. kāṟṟiliruntu eṉṉa uram (Fertiliser) eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu ?

9. vāṉavillil eṉṉa niṟaṅkaḷirukkiṉṟaṉa ?

14. eṉṉa ulōkaṅkaḷil kānta cakti uṇṭu ?

17. iṭimuḻakkam ceyyum mukilil miṉcāram celuttap paṭṭuḷḷa teṉpatik kaṇṭupiṭittavar yār ?
18. mutal mutalil aṇuvip piḷantavar yār ?

20. i°tāṉpul, ō°lō, ileṉiṉ kirāṭ, ayar, tilaṇṭ eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷiṉ paḻiya peyarkaḷeṉṉa ?

payiṟci viṉākkaḷukku viṭi
I
1. ilemiṅ eṉṉum elikaḷ. 2. kaḷḷi vakikaḷ. 3. apiṉ 4. hop° (Hops); hop° eṉpatu airōppiya nāṭukaḷil payiriṭappaṭum oruvakik koṭiyiṉ pūmoṭṭu. 5. irāṇi 6. ā°tirēliyāviṉ vaṭapakutiyil 7. pala° atiṉ (miṉērvā) ānti 8. 10 āṇṭukaḷ 9. olimpa° mali 10. vāṉa cāttiram 11. yōcep piri°ṭli (Joseph Priestly) 12. poṉ, piḷāṭṭiṉam, veḷḷi mutaliyavi 13. o°miyam (Osmium) 14. pātaracam 15. kalciyam kārpaṉēṭ, cōṭiyam kārpaṉēṭ, maknīciyam calpēṭ 16. cātāraṇa uppu, karumpuc carkkari, camiyaṟcōṭā 17. civappāka māṟum 18. aceṭṭik amilam (Acetic Acid) 19. ciṟṟik amilam (Citric Acid) iruppatāl 20. kantakam, kari, veṭiyuppu 21. (Hydrogen Sulphide) iruppatāl 22. atil cavukkāram nuriyātu pōṉāl 23. kārpaṉ moṉōkciṭ (Carbon Monoxide) 24. kāṟṟil pirāṇavāyuvum (Oxygen) nīrum iruppatāl 25. cempum nikkalum kalantu 26. maknīcayam. 
II
1. ammōṉiyam niṭrēṭ (Ammonium Nitrate) 2. picpiḷeṉṭ (Pitchblende) 3. kārpaṉ 4. veḷḷi puṟōmiṭ (Silver bromide) 5.nākam 6. cempu 7. tuṅ°tiṉ (Tungsten) 8. koḻuppōṭu kō°ṭik cōṭāvic cūṭākki 9. civappu, ārēñcu, mañcaḷ, pacci, nīlam, karu nīlam (Indigo), ūtā (Violet) 10. cēr yēm° ṭīvār (Sir James Dewar) 11. kaṭṭiyāṉa nīr nīrilum pārkkap parumi aṭivatāl 12. atil karintuḷḷa uppu kotiniliyi atikappaṭuttukiṟatu 13. cekkaṇṭukku 1,100 aṭi 14. irumpu, nikkal, kōpālṭ (Cobalt) 15.cempu, nākam, kantaka amilam 16. kalvaṉō mīṭṭar (Galvanometre) 17. peṉcamiṉ piṟaṅliṉ (Benjamin Franklin) 18. urutarpōrṭ (Lord Rutherford) 19. cattatti oru ticiyāka orumukap paṭuttum (Concentrate) karuvi 20. koṉ°tāntiṉōppiḷ, kiri°tiyāṉā, peṟrō kirāṭ, ayarlantu, cīyam 21. karip makkaḷiṉ (cevvintiyar) haṉṟakiṉ (Hunraken) eṉṉum colliliruntu ; avarkaḷ haṉṟakiṉ teyvam puyali uṇṭākkukiṟatu eṉa nampiṉārkaḷ. 22. īrāk 23. ka°piyaṉ kaṭal 24. nil, kalaraṭō, cintu 25. eṭiṉpēk, pēṇi (Berne), ili°paṉ, kōpāṭ (Hobart), irayō ṭi ceṉarō, iṭilli, pākṭāṭ, cantiyākō, pūṉā°ērī° (Buenos airies)
III
1. mattiya rēkiyiluḷḷatu; ēṟakkuṟiya 26mil 2. 24,926 mil 3.pireñcu, cērmaṉ, ittāliyam, urōmaṉ (Romansch) 4. 16. 5. ittāli, ā°tiriyā, i°pēyiṉ uruciyā 6. teṉṉamerikkā, teṉṉāppirikkā (taṭṭiyāṉakuṉṟu), uruciyā, teṉṉāppirikkā 7. āṅkilariṉ nāṭu 8. eṭvāṭ pattimāṉ 9. iṅkilāntil 1886il eḻutappaṭṭa nila aḷavi viparam 10. arapu 11. katē(Cathey) 12.cērvālṭar irali 13. mutalām yēm° aracaṉ 14.payar(Biar) 15. villō(Willow) 16.uroṭōciyā (Cecil Rhodes) 17. kōtā veṭṭuvāykkāl (Gota canal) cuviṭiṉ 115mil 18. timiṅkilac cuṟā(Whale shark) 19. nirōpi 20. pikkal vāvi (Lake bikal) 5000 aṭi 21. mēl 20 kīḻ 22. 22. uṟiñcum mīṉi (Sucking fish) 23. aṇṭākṭik pakuti 24. kaṭal tārā (Cormorant).
IV
1. iracavātam, 2. ṭelpi(Delphi), 3. 32,500 yār (kacam), 4. ve°ṭā (Vesta), 5. kōv vīḻcci (Khow Cataracts) intōcīṉāvil, 6. pokkiṭ (Bauxite), 7. cipirālṭar, kiyūṭā (Ceuta), 8. cēr jōṭ° evare°ṭ (Sir George Everest 1790-1866) eṉṉum intiya cērvē ceṉaraliṉ peyarāl, 9.tōliṉ kīḻuḷḷa koḻuppiliruntu, 10. karuṅkaṭal, kā°piyaṉ kaṭal, mattiyatarik kaṭal, atlāntikkaṭal, ākṭikkaṭal, 11. ekiptukkum arāpiyāvukku miṭiyil: vimiṅ (Wyming)aikkiya amerikkāvil ; cīṉā, ā°tiriyā, nīyū cavutvēl° (nīlakiri maliyum nīlamali eṉappaṭum); mo°kkō, 12. āppirikka mattiyarēkik kāṭukaḷ, kirīṉlantu, mattiya āciyā, arāpiyā, niyūcilantu, pēru, ukkirēṉ, mekcikkō, vaṭa amerikkā, piṉlāntu, 13. ākṭik, vaṭa amerikkā, cīṉā, cīyam, niyukiṉi, 14. ulaka cukātāra tāpaṉam (World Health Organisation), 15. maraṇa taṇṭaṉi vitikkumpōtu, 16. ilāpā° (Le Paz), pōlviyā, 17. ciṟutti, 18. aṭla°, 19. iṭaccu, 20. paṉāmā 50 mil; cuya° 100mil, 21. urōmar (Romer 1644-1710) 1676-l 22. hiṭiracaṉ, 23. atu ciṟitu pōrmik amilatti (Formic acid) uṭalil celuttuvatāl. 24. alumiṉiyam,mākṉīciyam, 25. irēṭiyam.
